title.zh: 卷17 本紀十七 宣宗本紀一
title.raw: 卷17 本紀十七 宣宗本紀一

sentences.zh: 宣宗效天符運立中體正至文聖武智勇仁慈儉勤孝敏寬定成皇帝，諱旻寧，仁宗次子。

translations.literal: The Emperor Xuanzong, who accorded with Heaven and bore the mandate, established the central body, rectified the ultimate, was cultured and sagely, martial and wise, brave and benevolent, frugal and diligent, filial and keen, tolerant and steadfast in accomplishment—taboo name Minning—was the second son of the Renzong Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong, taboo Minning, was Renzong's second son; his posthumous titles praise Heaven's mandate, central order, and accomplished sagacity.

sentences.zh: 母孝淑睿皇后，乾隆四十七年八月初十日，生上於擷芳殿。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Xiaoshu Rui; on the tenth day of the eighth month, Qianlong 47, he was born in the Palace of Gathering Fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Xiaoshu Rui; he was born in Qianlong 47, eighth month, day 10, at the Palace of Gathering Fragrance.

sentences.zh: 幼好學，從編修秦承業、檢討萬承風先後受讀。

translations.literal: In youth he loved study; he received instruction in turn from compilers Qin Chengye and Wan Chengfeng.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he studied with Qin Chengye and Wan Chengfeng in succession.

sentences.zh: 又與禮部右侍郎汪廷珍、翰林侍讀學士徐頲朝夕講論。

translations.literal: He also discussed day and night with Vice Minister of Rites Wang Tingzhen and Hanlin Reader Xu Ying.
translations.idiomatic: He debated daily with Wang Tingzhen and Xu Ying.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十六年八月，高宗行圍威遜格爾，上引弓獲鹿，高宗大喜，賜黃馬褂、花翎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of Qianlong 56, when the Gaozong Emperor went on the encircling hunt at Weixunge'er, the Emperor drew his bow and took a deer; the Gaozong Emperor was greatly pleased and bestowed a yellow jacket and peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 56, month 8, at Weixunge'er Hongli saw Minning shoot a deer and gave him a yellow jacket and peacock plume.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，娶孝穆成皇后。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 1 he married Empress Xiaomu Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he wed Empress Xiaomu Cheng.

sentences.zh: 四年四月戊戌，仁宗遵建儲家法，親書上名，緘藏鐍匣。

translations.literal: On day wuxu in the fourth month of year 4, the Renzong Emperor, following the house law for establishing an heir, personally wrote the Emperor's name and sealed it in the locked casket.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in month 4 of Jiaqing 4, Renzong wrote Minning's name and sealed it in the heir-apparent casket.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，孝穆成皇后薨，繼娶孝慎成皇后。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 13, Empress Xiaomu Cheng died; he then married Empress Xiaoshen Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 13, month 1, Empress Xiaomu Cheng died; he then wed Empress Xiaoshen Cheng.

sentences.zh: 十八年九月，從幸秋獮木蘭，上先還京師，而教匪林清党犯闕之變作。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of year 18, while accompanying the fortune on the autumn hunt at Mulan, the Emperor returned first to the capital, and the affair of teaching-bandit Lin Qing's party assaulting the palace occurred.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 18, month 9, Minning returned early from the Mulan hunt while Lin Qing's sect stormed the palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，戊寅，賊入內右門，至養心殿南，欲北竄。

translations.literal: That month, on day wuyin, the bandits entered the inner right gate, reached south of the Hall of Mental Cultivation, and wished to flee north.
translations.idiomatic: That month, on wuyin, rebels reached the Hall of Mental Cultivation and tried to break north.

sentences.zh: 上御槍斃二賊，餘賊潰散，亂始平。

translations.literal: The Emperor wielded his gun and shot dead two bandits; the rest dispersed in rout, and the disturbance was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Minning shot two rebels with his musket; the rest fled and order returned.

sentences.zh: 飛章上聞。

translations.literal: A flying memorial reported the matter to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: An urgent memorial reported the fight to the throne.

sentences.zh: 仁宗欣慰，封上為智親王，號所禦槍曰「威烈」。

translations.literal: The Renzong Emperor was gratified, enfeoffed the Emperor as Prince Zhi, and titled the gun he wielded "Weilie."
translations.idiomatic: Renzong made Minning Prince Zhi and named his musket Weilie.

sentences.zh: 諭內閣曰：「忠孝兼備，豈容稍靳恩施。

translations.literal: An edict to the Grand Secretariat said: "Loyalty and filial piety in full measure—how could favors be stinted?
translations.idiomatic: Renzong told the Grand Secretariat that Minning's loyalty and filial piety deserved full reward.

sentences.zh: 」上謙沖不自滿假，謝恩奏言：「事在倉猝，又無禦賊之人，勢不由己，事後愈思愈恐。

translations.literal: " The Emperor, modest and not presuming on merit, thanked grace and memorialized: "The affair came in sudden haste; there was no one to fight the bandits, and I had no choice. The more I reflect afterward, the more I fear.
translations.idiomatic: Minning refused the praise and wrote that the fight was sudden, that he had no guards, and that he grew more afraid on reflection.

sentences.zh: 」其不矜不伐如此。

translations.literal: " Such was his humility without boasting.
translations.idiomatic: That was how little he boasted of himself.

sentences.zh: 二十五年秋七年，仁宗秋獮熱河，上隨扈。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the twenty-fifth year, the Renzong Emperor's autumn encampment hunt at Rehe was held; the Emperor followed in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 25, autumn, Minning followed Renzong to the Rehe hunt.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，仁宗不豫，己卯，大漸，御前大臣賽沖阿、索特納木多布齋，軍機大臣托津、戴均元、盧廕溥、文孚，總管內務府禧恩、和世泰公啟鐍匣，宣示嘉慶四年御書，立上為皇太子。

translations.literal: On day wuyin the Renzong Emperor fell ill; on day jimao he was gravely ill. Grand Ministers in Attendance Saichong'a and Sotnamu Dobche, Military Grand Councilors Tuojin, Dai Junyuan, Lu Yinpu, and Wen Fu, and chief stewards of the Imperial Household Department Xi En and Heshen Tai opened the sealed casket and proclaimed the Jiaqing 4 imperial handwriting, establishing the Emperor as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Renzong fell ill; on jimao he worsened. Saichong'a, Tuojin, and others opened the casket and proclaimed Minning heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 仁宗崩，即日奉大行皇帝梓宮回京。

translations.literal: When the Renzong Emperor died, that same day they escorted the late Emperor's coffin back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong died, his coffin left for Beijing the same day.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，尊母后為皇太后，晉封惇郡王釂愷為惇親王，釂愉為惠郡王。

translations.literal: On day xinsi the mother was honored as Empress Dowager; Prince Dun Miankai was raised to Prince of the First Rank Dun; Mianyu to Prince of the Second Rank Hui.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the mother became Empress Dowager; Miankai became Prince Dun and Mianyu Prince Hui.

sentences.zh: 癸未，奉皇太后懿旨：「大行皇帝龍馭上賓，皇次子智親王仁孝聰睿，英武端醇，見隨行在，自當上膺付讬，撫馭黎元。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, by the Empress Dowager's decree: "The late Emperor's dragon coach has ascended on high; the second imperial son, Prince Zhi, is humane, filial, intelligent, and perspicacious, brave and upright in bearing, and is with the entourage—he should surely receive the entrustment and govern the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Empress Dowager decreed that Prince Zhi, with the court at Rehe, should receive the throne and rule the people.

sentences.zh: 但恐倉卒之中，大行皇帝未及明諭，而皇次子秉性謙沖，予所深知。

translations.literal: Yet fearing that in haste the late Emperor had no time to make clear instruction, and the second imperial son by nature is modest—I know this well.
translations.idiomatic: She feared Renzong had not spoken clearly in haste and knew the prince was modest by nature.

sentences.zh: 為降諭旨，傳諭留京王大臣，馳寄皇次子，即正尊位。

translations.literal: Therefore an edict is sent down, transmitted to the Beijing princes and grandees, sent posthaste to the second imperial son, to take the supreme place immediately.
translations.idiomatic: She ordered Beijing princes and ministers to tell him at once to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 」上奉懿旨，恭摺覆奏，並將御前大臣等啟鐍匣所藏嘉慶四年四月立皇太子硃諭進呈。

translations.literal: " The Emperor received the decree, respectfully memorialized in reply, and presented the vermillion edict of Jiaqing 4, fourth month, establishing the heir apparent, from what the Grand Ministers in Attendance and others had opened in the sealed casket.
translations.idiomatic: Minning obeyed, replied respectfully, and presented the Jiaqing 4 heir-apparent edict from the casket.

sentences.zh: 召在籍翰林院侍講秦承業來京。

translations.literal: Qin Chengye, Hanlin Reader-at-large, was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Qin Chengye was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，命遵古制行三年之喪，臣民仍照定例持服。

translations.literal: On day yiyou in the eighth month, he was ordered to observe the ancient three-year mourning, while subjects still followed the fixed term of dress.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in month 8, the court took three-year mourning while subjects kept the usual mourning term.

sentences.zh: 免直隸承德府屬及經過宛平等五州縣明年額賦。

translations.literal: Next year's quota taxes were remitted for Chengde prefecture and its subordinates and five districts including Wanping along the route.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's taxes were waived for Chengde and five route districts including Wanping.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，允王大臣請，持服百日。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the princes' and ministers' request to observe mourning for one hundred days was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court was allowed to mourn one hundred days.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大行皇帝梓宮還京師。

translations.literal: On day weimo, the late Emperor's coffin returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On weimo the late emperor's coffin reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 御史袁銑疏陳定規模、正好惡七事。

translations.literal: Censor Yuan Xian memorialized seven matters on fixing standards and distinguishing good and evil.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Yuan Xian proposed seven reforms on standards and moral judgment.

sentences.zh: 上優詔嘉納之。

translations.literal: The Emperor issued a favorable edict praising and adopting it.
translations.idiomatic: Minning praised the memorial and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 加方受疇太子太保。

translations.literal: Fang Shoudi was added Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Shoudi became Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大學士、九卿等奏上大行皇帝廟號尊諡曰仁宗受天興運敷化綏猷崇文經武孝恭勤儉端敏英哲睿皇帝。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Grand Secretariat and Nine Ministers submitted the late Emperor's temple name and honorific title: Renzong, Received Heaven, Raised Fortune, Spread Transformation, Secured the Plan, Honored Culture, Regulated Arms, Filial, Respectful, Diligent, Frugal, Upright, Keen, Wise, and Perspicacious Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the court named Renzong and gave his full posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 頒大行皇帝遺詔于朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、越南、緬甸諸國。

translations.literal: The late Emperor's testamentary edict was promulgated to Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Vietnam, Burma, and other states.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong's testament was sent to Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, Vietnam, Burma, and others.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上即皇帝位於太和殿，告祭天地、太廟、社稷，頒詔天下，以明年為道光元年。

translations.literal: On day gengxu the Emperor took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Harmony, reported to Heaven, Earth, the Ancestral Temple, and the Altar of Soil and Grain, promulgated an edict empire-wide, and made the next year Daoguang 1.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Minning ascended at the Hall of Supreme Harmony, sacrificed to Heaven, Earth, and the altars, and made the next year Daoguang 1.

sentences.zh: 加恩中外，非常赦不原者，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: Grace was extended within and without; those not forgiven by extraordinary amnesty were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty covered all crimes not excluded by extraordinary pardon.

sentences.zh: 加黃鉞、劉鐶之、賽沖阿、孫玉庭、蔣攸銛太子少保。

translations.literal: Huang Yue, Liu Chengzhi, Saichong'a, Sun Yuting, and Jiang Yinshe were made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yue, Liu Chengzhi, Saichong'a, Sun Yuting, and Jiang Yinshe became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day xinhai autumn executions were halted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai autumn executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑河南許州地震災。

translations.literal: That month, Xu Prefecture, Henan, earthquake disaster was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month Henan's Xu Prefecture earthquake victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 貸盛彰武臺邊門等處被淹兵丁一年錢糧，並給修屋費。

translations.literal: Soldiers drowned at Shengzhangwutai and other border posts were lent one year's pay and grain, with house-repair funds given.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded border garrisons at Shengzhangwutai and elsewhere received a year's pay, grain, and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 貸巨流河等處一月口糧。

translations.literal: One month's rations were lent at Juliu River and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: One month's rations were lent at Juliu River and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，尊大行皇帝陵曰昌陵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei in the ninth month the late Emperor's mausoleum was titled Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in month 9 the late emperor's tomb was named Changling.

sentences.zh: 庚申，切責軍機大臣，以擬遺詔錯誤，罷托津、戴均元軍機大臣，文孚、盧廕溥仍留軍機大臣，均下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day gengshen the Military Grand Councilors were sharply rebuked for errors in drafting the testament; Tuojin and Dai Junyuan were dismissed from the Grand Council; Wen Fu and Lu Yinpu remained; all were referred for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Tuojin and Dai Junyuan left the Grand Council over a flawed testament draft; Wen Fu and Lu Yinpu stayed; all faced severe review.

sentences.zh: 斌靜奏沖巴噶什愛曼布魯特比蘇蘭奇糾薩木薩克之子張格爾作亂。

translations.literal: Bin Jing reported that the Aiman of Chibaghash, Bruke chief Susuwanqi, had stirred up Jahangir, son of the Saman Sakk, to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Bin Jing reported Jahangir, stirred up by Susuwanqi, in revolt at Chibaghash.

sentences.zh: 命慶祥兼程赴喀什噶爾剿之。

translations.literal: Qing Xiang was ordered to hurry to Kashgar to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Qing Xiang was sent posthaste to Kashgar to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 命大學士曹振鏞，尚書黃鉞、英和在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Cao Zhengyong and Ministers Huang Yue and Yinghe were ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhengyong, Huang Yue, and Yinghe joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以那彥成為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day renxu Nayancheng was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Nayancheng took the Colonial Affairs ministry.

sentences.zh: 命吏部尚書、協辦大學士吳璥督理河南儀封河工。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel and Associate Grand Secretary Wu Jun was ordered to supervise Henan Yifeng River works.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jun was ordered to supervise the Henan Yifeng River project.

sentences.zh: 調劉鐶之為吏部尚書，茹棻為兵部尚書，盧廕溥為工部尚書，黃鉞為戶部尚書，汪廷珍為禮部尚書，顧德慶為左都御史。

translations.literal: Liu Chengzhi was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Ru Fen to War; Lu Yinpu to Works; Huang Yue to Revenue; Wang Tingzhen to Rites; Gu Deqing to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chengzhi took personnel; Ru Fen war; Lu Yinpu works; Huang Yue revenue; Wang Tingzhen rites; Gu Deqing the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 起松筠為左副都御史。

translations.literal: Songyun was recalled as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun returned as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以秦承業為翰林院侍講學士，命在上書房行走。

translations.literal: On day wuchen Qin Chengye was made Hanlin Reader and ordered to serve in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Qin Chengye became Hanlin reader and served in the Upper Study.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上始禦西廠幄次，引見廷臣。

translations.literal: On day gengwu the Emperor for the first time held court at the western factory curtain and received the court ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Minning first held court at the western factory curtain and received ministers.

sentences.zh: 詔開鄉會試恩科。

translations.literal: An edict opened a special provincial and metropolitan examination year.
translations.idiomatic: A special civil-service examination year was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 命臣工切實言事。

translations.literal: Ministers were ordered to memorialize facts genuinely.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were told to speak frankly in memorials.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，豫親王裕興以罪奪爵圈禁。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Prince Yu Xing of the Bordered Yellow Banner was deprived of his rank and confined for crime.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Prince Yu Xing lost his rank and was confined.

sentences.zh: 壬午，加提督楊遇春太子少保，賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: On day renwu Brigadier Yang Yuchun was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and granted double peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Yang Yuchun became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with double peacock plumes.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑河南睢州等七州縣水災，並給睢州等四州縣一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, seven Henan districts including Suizhou were relieved for flood, with one month's rations for four districts including Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month seven Henan flood districts were relieved, four with a month's rations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，調英和為戶部尚書，那彥成為吏部尚書，穆克登額為工部尚書，普恭為禮部尚書，和世泰為理籓院尚書，松筠為左都御史。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuzi: Yinghe was transferred to Minister of Revenue; Nayancheng to Personnel; Mukedeng'e to Works; Pugong to Rites; Heshen Tai to Colonial Affairs; Songyun to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuzi, Yinghe took revenue, Nayancheng personnel, Mukedeng'e works, Pugong rites, Heshen Tai colonial affairs, Songyun the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上大行皇帝尊諡廟號。

translations.literal: On day xinchou the late Emperor's honorific temple name was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the late emperor received his temple name and honorific.

sentences.zh: 翌日，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: The next day an edict was promulgated empire-wide; grace was extended by degree.
translations.idiomatic: The next day an empire-wide edict granted graded favors.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，賑江蘇被水江寧等八州縣、安徽被水鳳陽等府所屬州縣。

translations.literal: On day jiachen Jiangsu's eight flooded districts including Jiangning were relieved; Anhui's Fengyang and subordinate districts for water disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen eight flooded Jiangsu districts including Jiangning and Fengyang in Anhui were relieved.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以德英阿為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day wushen Deying'a was made Urumqi commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Deying'a became Urumqi commander.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江南海州、安徽泗州等八州縣及屯衛水旱災。

translations.literal: That month, eight districts including Haizhou in Jiangnan and Sizhou in Anhui for flood and drought; tunwei as well.
translations.idiomatic: That month eight Jiangnan and Anhui districts, including tunwei settlements, were relieved for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 給浙江蕭山等三十三縣貧民口糧。

translations.literal: Poor of thirty-three Zhejiang counties including Xiaoshan were given rations.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-three Zhejiang counties including Xiaoshan received poor relief grain.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，上奉皇太后居壽康宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: the Emperor installed the Empress Dowager at the Palace of Longevity and Health.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, bingchen, Minning installed the Empress Dowager at the Palace of Longevity and Health.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以魏元煜為江蘇巡撫，左輔為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuchen Wei Yuanyu was made Jiangsu governor; Zuo Fu Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wei Yuanyu took Jiangsu and Zuo Fu Hunan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，冬至，祀天於圜丘。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, winter solstice, Heaven was sacrificed to at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the winter solstice, Minning sacrificed to Heaven at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 自是每歲如之。

translations.literal: Henceforth this was done every year.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he did so every year.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以誠安為左都御史，松筠為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day guiyou Chengan was made Left Censor-in-Chief; Songyun Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Chengan took the left censorate and Songyun became Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，誠安改鑲黃旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu Chengan was transferred to Bordered Yellow Chinese Banner commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Chengan became Bordered Yellow Chinese Banner commander.

sentences.zh: 以文孚為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wen Fu was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu took the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，翰林院侍講學士顧蓴奏松筠宜置左右，忤旨，下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day dingchou Hanlin Reader Gu Chun memorialized that Songyun should be kept at the Emperor's side; he offended the throne and was referred for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Gu Chun urged keeping Songyun near the throne, offended the Emperor, and faced severe review.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，上皇太后徽號曰恭慈皇太后。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: the Empress Dowager was given the honorific Empress Dowager Gongci.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiashen, the Empress Dowager received the honorific Gongci.

sentences.zh: 翌日，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: The next day an edict was promulgated empire-wide; grace was extended by degree.
translations.idiomatic: The next day an empire-wide edict granted graded favors.

sentences.zh: 諭奉皇太后懿旨，立皇帝繼妃佟佳氏為皇后。

translations.literal: An edict transmitted the Empress Dowager's decree: the Emperor's consort, Lady Niohuru of the second rank, was installed as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: By the Empress Dowager's order Minning's consort Niohuru became Empress.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，和世泰改福州將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingxu Heshen Tai was transferred to Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Heshen Tai became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 以晉昌為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Jinchang was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchang took the Colonial Affairs ministry.

sentences.zh: 調慶保為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Qingbao was transferred to Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Qingbao became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以史致光為雲貴總督，韓克均為雲南巡撫，顏檢為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Shi Zhiguang was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; Han Kejun Yunnan governor; Yan Jian Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhiguang took Yunnan-Guizhou; Han Kejun Yunnan; Yan Jian Fujian.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，河南儀封決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day gengyin the Henan Yifeng breach closed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Henan Yifeng dike closed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，加上孝敬憲皇后、孝聖憲皇后、高宗純皇帝、孝賢純皇后、孝儀純皇后尊諡。

translations.literal: On day guisi added honorific titles for Empress Xiaogong Xian, Xiaosheng Xian, the Gaozong Chun Emperor, Xiaoxian Chun Empress, and Xiaoyi Chun Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi added posthumous titles for earlier empresses and Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 英和罷軍機大臣，照舊供尚書等職。

translations.literal: Yinghe was dismissed from the Grand Council and continued at his former ministerial posts.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghe left the Grand Council but kept his ministries.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以汪廷珍、湯金釗、方受疇、蔣攸銛言查陋規不便予議敘，孫玉庭奏尤為剴切，溫諭褒之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen because Wang Tingzhen, Tang Jinzhao, Fang Shoudi, and Jiang Yinshe spoke on investigating corrupt practices and were inconvenient to reward, while Sun Yuting's memorial was especially pointed—a warm edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wang Tingzhen and others were passed over for rewards after attacking corrupt fees, but Sun Yuting's pointed memorial won warm praise.

sentences.zh: 起李鴻賓為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Li Hongbin was recalled as Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongbin returned as Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 召張映漢來京，以陳若霖為湖廣總督，帥承瀛為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhang Yinghan was summoned to the capital; Chen Ruolin was made Huguang governor-general; Shuai Chengying Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yinghan was called to Beijing; Chen Ruolin took Huguang; Shuai Chengying Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 道光元年春正月癸丑，禦太和殿受朝，樂設而不作，不讀賀表。

translations.literal: Daoguang 1, spring, first month, day guichou: the Emperor received court at the Hall of Supreme Harmony; music was set but not played; felicitations were not read.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1, month 1, guichou, Minning received court at the Hall of Supreme Harmony without music or congratulatory scrolls.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賞刑部員外郎初彭齡禮部侍郎銜。

translations.literal: On day bingchen Junior Secretary Chu Pengling of the Board of Punishments was granted Vice Minister of Rites rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Chu Pengling of Punishments received Vice Minister of Rites rank.

sentences.zh: 裁浙江鹽政，以巡撫兼管。

translations.literal: The Zhejiang salt controller post was abolished; the governor was to oversee it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's salt post was abolished and the governor took charge.

sentences.zh: 己未，以文孚為禮部尚書，那清安為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiwei Wen Fu was made Minister of Rites; Na Qing'an Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wen Fu took rites and Na Qing'an the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，越南進香，表賀，貢方物，詔止之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao Vietnam sent an incense offering, congratulatory memorial, and tribute; an edict ordered it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Vietnam's incense mission and tribute were refused by edict.

sentences.zh: 丙子，朝鮮國王李鍚奉表慰唁；

translations.literal: On day bingzi the King of Korea Li Xi offered a memorial of condolence;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Korea's King Li Xi sent a condolence memorial;

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀王熱尊達爾畢噶爾瑪薩野奏仁宗升遐成服，貢金緞，賜敕嘉賚之。

translations.literal: the King of Nepal Hotradandabigarmasaya reported mourning for Renzong's ascension, presented gold brocade; an imperial letter granted praise and reward.
translations.idiomatic: Nepal's king mourned Renzong, sent gold brocade, and received an imperial letter of praise.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午朔，日食。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day renwu: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 班禪額爾德尼進貢物，賜敕褒嘉賚之。

translations.literal: The Panchen Lama sent tribute objects; an imperial letter praised and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: The Panchen Lama sent tribute and received an imperial letter of praise and reward.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，協辦大學士吳璥予告。

translations.literal: On day wuxu Associate Grand Secretary Wu Jun was granted leave.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wu Jun retired on leave.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命孫玉庭為協辦大學士，仍留兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day gengzi Sun Yuting was ordered Associate Grand Secretary while remaining Liang-Jiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Sun Yuting became associate grand secretary while staying at Liang-Jiang.

sentences.zh: 加陝甘總督長齡太子少保。

translations.literal: Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Changling was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Changling became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免江西豐城等六縣民借籽種口糧逋穀。

translations.literal: On day jiachen seed-loan grain arrears were remitted for six Jiangxi counties including Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen six Jiangxi counties including Fengcheng lost seed-loan grain arrears.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，欽天監奏，本年四月初一日，日月合璧，五星聯珠。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day xinhai: the Directorate of Astronomy reported that on the first day of the fourth month this year the sun and moon would join in brilliance and the five planets align in a pearl string.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, xinhai new moon, the Astronomical Bureau reported a sun-moon conjunction and five-planet alignment on the first day of month 4.

sentences.zh: 詔：「益勵寅恭，與內外臣工共圖上理，不必宣付史館。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Strive still more in reverent diligence, work with inner and outer officials alike toward good governance; there is no need to announce this to the historiographical office."
translations.idiomatic: The court urged greater reverent diligence with all officials and said the edict need not go to the historiographers.

sentences.zh: 」壬子，以送仁宗睿皇帝梓宮至山陵，命莊親王綿課等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because the coffin of the late Emperor Renzong was being escorted to the mausoleum, Prince Zhuang Mianke and others were ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Prince Zhuang Mianke and others stayed in Beijing while Renzong's coffin went to the tomb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，再免經過地方本年旗租，並給麥田籽種。

translations.literal: On day guichou, banner rents for the current year were again remitted for places along the route, and wheat-field seed was distributed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, banner rents along the route were remitted again and wheat seed was issued.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，仁宗睿皇帝發引，上奉皇太后送至昌陵。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the late Emperor Renzong's funeral cortege set out; the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Renzong's funeral cortege departed and the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Changling.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，廓爾喀進登極表貢，命與道光二年例貢同進。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Gurkha presented enthronement tribute; they were ordered to present it together with the regular tribute of Daoguang 2.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Gurkha sent enthronement tribute and was told to combine it with the Daoguang 2 regular tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵、隆恩殿，上孝淑睿皇后尊諡曰孝淑端和仁莊慈懿光天佑聖睿皇后。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, Changling, and the Hall of Imperial Grace, and bestowed the posthumous honorific on Empress Xiaoshu Rui as Xiaoshu Duanhe Renzhuang Ciyi Guangtian Yousheng Rui Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Emperor visited the western tombs and gave Empress Xiaoshu Rui her full posthumous title.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命成都將軍呢瑪善赴雲南幫辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Chengdu General Ni Mashaan was ordered to Yunnan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Ni Mashaan was sent from Chengdu to assist Yunnan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，葬仁宗睿皇帝于昌陵。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the late Emperor Renzong was buried at Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Renzong was buried at Changling.

sentences.zh: 加托津、曹振鏞太子太傅。

translations.literal: Tuojin and Cao Zhengyong were advanced to Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Tuojin and Cao Zhengyong were made Grand Tutors of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor brought the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，仁宗睿皇帝、孝淑睿皇后升祔太廟。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the late Emperor Renzong and Empress Xiaoshu Rui were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Renzong and Empress Xiaoshu Rui were installed in the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以升祔禮成，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day jimao, because the temple installation was complete, an edict was promulgated empire-wide and grace was distributed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the temple rites finished and an empire-wide amnesty was granted in degrees.

sentences.zh: 命貴州提督羅思舉赴雲南軍營協剿。

translations.literal: Guizhou Provincial Military Commander Luo Siju was ordered to the Yunnan army camp to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Siju was ordered from Guizhou to the Yunnan camps to assist in suppression.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西岢嵐等十州縣、甘肅狄道等五州縣上年災民倉穀口糧。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain for famine rations was lent to disaster victims of the previous year in ten Shanxi prefectures and counties including Kelan and five Gansu prefectures and counties including Didao.
translations.idiomatic: That month, last year's disaster victims in Shanxi and Gansu were lent granary grain for rations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，常雩，祀天於圜丘，仁宗睿皇帝配享，自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: the regular rain prayer; Heaven was worshipped at the Circular Mound Altar with the late Emperor Renzong as associate spirit; henceforth this was done annually.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, bingxu, the regular rain prayer at the Circular Mound paired Renzong; this became annual.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，授呢瑪善為欽差大臣，督辦雲南永北軍務。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Ni Mashaan was made Imperial Commissioner and ordered to oversee Yunnan Yongbei military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Ni Mashaan became Imperial Commissioner for Yunnan Yongbei affairs.

sentences.zh: 授那清安左都御史。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 大學士、三等侯明亮致仕。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary, third-rank marquis Mingliang retired.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Mingliang retired.

sentences.zh: 命戴均元、穆克登額、阿克當阿相度萬年吉地。

translations.literal: Dai Junyuan, Mukedenge, and Akedang'a were ordered to survey the auspicious site for the eternal tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan, Mukedenge, and Akedang'a were ordered to survey the imperial tomb site.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，雲南大姚拉古賊平。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Yunnan Dayao Lagu rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the Dayao Lagu rebels in Yunnan were pacified.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上詣大高殿祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to the Hall of Supreme Harmony to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

sentences.zh: 戊午，撥江蘇海州等州縣賑銀四十五萬六千兩。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, 456,000 taels of relief silver were allocated for Haizhou and other Jiangsu prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, 456,000 taels of relief silver went to Jiangsu prefectures including Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 命伯麟為大學士管兵部。

translations.literal: Bo Lin was made Grand Secretary in charge of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: Bo Lin became Grand Secretary supervising the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 以長齡為協辦大學士，仍留陝甘總督任。

translations.literal: Chang Ling was made Associate Grand Secretary while remaining Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling became Associate Grand Secretary and kept the Shaanxi-Gansu post.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day guihai, an edict halted autumn executions for the year.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, autumn executions were halted for the year.

sentences.zh: 甲子，授伯麟體仁閣大學士，曹振鏞武英殿大學士。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Bo Lin was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of the Esteemed and Humane; Cao Zhengyong of the Hall of Military Glory.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Bo Lin joined the Esteemed and Humane Hall and Cao Zhengyong the Military Glory Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，封阮福皎為越南國王。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Ruan Fuzhao was enfeoffed as king of Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Ruan Fuzhao was enfeoffed as king of Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 以松筠為兵部尚書，慶惠為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Songyun was made Minister of War and Qinghui Commander-in-Chief of Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun took war and Qinghui took Rehe.

sentences.zh: 壬申，夏至，祭地于方澤，仁宗睿皇帝配享，自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the summer solstice: Earth was worshipped at the Square Mound Altar with the late Emperor Renzong as associate spirit; henceforth this was done annually.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the summer solstice rites at the Square Mound paired Renzong; this became annual.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，雲南永北大姚賊平。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Yunnan Yongbei Dayao rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Yongbei Dayao rebels in Yunnan were pacified.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，以張師誠為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinsi: Zhang Shicheng was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, xinsi, Zhang Shicheng became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，安定門災。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, fire broke out at the Anding Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Anding Gate burned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上御太和門，命鄭親王烏爾恭阿、順承郡王倫柱齎冊寶詣孝穆皇后殯宮行冊諡禮。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor took the Hall of Supreme Harmony and ordered Prince Zheng Wuer Gong'a and Prince Shuncheng Lunzhu to carry seals and credentials to the mourning palace of Empress Xiaomu to perform enshrinement and posthumous honorific rites.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Emperor ordered Princes Zheng and Shuncheng to take seals to Empress Xiaomu's mourning palace for enshrinement rites.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，召成齡來京，以李鴻賓為漕運總督，孫爾准為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Cheng Ling was recalled to the capital; Li Hongbin was made Grand Canal Transport Director; Sun Erzhun Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Cheng Ling was recalled; Li Hongbin took the canal and Sun Erzhun took Anhui.

sentences.zh: 除河南新鄉縣地賦。

translations.literal: Land tax for Xinxiang county, Henan, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Xinxiang county's land tax in Henan was remitted.

sentences.zh: 以琦善為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Qishan was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，刑部尚書和瑛卒，調那彥成為刑部尚書，松筠為吏部尚書，晉昌為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: Minister of Punishments He Yong died; Na Yancheng was transferred to Minister of Punishments, Songyun to Minister of Personnel, Jin Chang to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, gengxu, He Yong died; Na Yancheng took punishments, Songyun personnel, and Jin Chang war.

sentences.zh: 以穆克登布為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Mukedengbu was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Mukedengbu became Minister of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，嚴烺以三品頂戴署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Yan Huang was made acting Grand Canal Transport Director for the Eastern Hebei section with third-rank hat ornament.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yan Huang acted as eastern-route canal director with third-rank rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，調毓岱為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Yu Dai was transferred to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Yu Dai became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以楊懋恬為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Maotian was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Maotian became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上奉皇太后謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the Western Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota taxes for places along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Western Tombs and cut route taxes by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day renshen, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the Emperor brought the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑甘肅寧夏等四縣水旱災，並免上年額賦。

translations.literal: That month, Ningxia and three other Gansu counties suffering flood and drought were relieved, and the previous year's quota taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, four Gansu counties including Ningxia were relieved and last year's taxes remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，展順天鄉試於九月舉行。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen: the Shuntian provincial examination was postponed to the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, gengchen, the Shuntian provincial exam was moved to month 9.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命松筠在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Songyun was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Songyun joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 以特依順保為烏裏雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Te Yishunbao was made General of Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Te Yishunbao became General of Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，兵部尚書茹棻卒，以初彭齡代之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Minister of War Ru Fen died; Chu Pengling succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Ru Fen died and Chu Pengling took war.

sentences.zh: 乙未，霍罕遣使請入覲，卻之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Kokand sent envoys requesting an audience; it was declined.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Kokand's request for an audience was declined.

sentences.zh: 丙午，調張師誠為安徽巡撫，孫爾准為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zhang Shicheng was transferred to Anhui governor and Sun Erzhun to Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhang Shicheng went to Anhui and Sun Erzhun to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，暹羅國王鄭佛遣使進香、貢方物，溫諭止之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuchen: the king of Siam, Zheng Fo, sent envoys to offer incense and regional products; a gentle edict stopped them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, wuchen, Siam's incense tribute was gently refused.

sentences.zh: 己巳，召長齡來京，以硃勳署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Chang Ling was recalled; Zhu Xun acted as Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Chang Ling was recalled and Zhu Xun acted for Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽宿州等三州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, Suzhou and two other Anhui prefectures and counties suffering flood were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three Anhui prefectures including Suzhou were flood-reliefed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，上御乾清門聽政，自是歲以為常。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: the Emperor held court at the Gate of Heavenly Purity to hear government; henceforth this was done annually.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, jimao, the Emperor heard government at the Gate of Heavenly Purity; this became annual.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，調孫爾准為安徽巡撫，嵩孚為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Sun Erzhun was transferred to Anhui governor and Song Fu to Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Sun Erzhun went to Anhui and Song Fu to Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，貴州巡撫陳若霖奏請歲減民、苗佃租二萬二千石，給苗疆會試舉人川費，允之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiwei: Guizhou Governor Chen Ruolin memorialized to reduce annual rent from Han and Miao tenants by 22,000 shi to fund metropolitan examination travel for Miao-frontier graduates; approved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, jiwei, Chen Ruolin's plan to cut Miao rent for exam travel funds was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以河防功加黎世序太子太保銜。

translations.literal: On day renxu, for river-control merit Li Shixu was given the supplementary title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Li Shixu gained Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent for river work.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，以邱樹棠為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi: Qiu Shutang was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, wuzi, Qiu Shutang became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，吏部尚書劉鐶之卒，調盧廕溥為吏部尚書，免軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Minister of Personnel Liu Huanzhi died; Lu Yinpu was transferred to Minister of Personnel and dismissed from the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Liu Huanzhi died; Lu Yinpu took personnel and left the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 調初彭齡為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Chu Pengling was transferred to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Pengling became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 以戴聯奎為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Dai Liankui was made Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Liankui became Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、越南、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Vietnam, and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Vietnam, and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁未朔，方受疇病免，以顏檢為直隸總督，長齡署之。

translations.literal: Spring, year 2, first month, new moon on dingwei: Fang Shouchou was dismissed for illness; Yan Jian was made Zhili Governor-General with Chang Ling acting.
translations.idiomatic: Daoguang 2, month 1 new moon: ill Fang Shouchou left office; Yan Jian took Zhili with Chang Ling acting.

sentences.zh: 以葉世倬為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Ye Shizhuo was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Shizhuo became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，祈穀於上帝，仁宗睿皇帝配享，自是每歲如之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, grain was prayed for to the Lord on High with the late Emperor Renzong as associate; henceforth this was done yearly.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the grain prayer paired Renzong; this became yearly.

sentences.zh: 庚午，召特依順保來京，調奕顥為烏裏雅蘇台將軍，松筠為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Te Yishunbao was recalled; Yi Hao was made General of Uliastai and Songyun General of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Te Yishunbao was recalled; Yi Hao took Uliastai and Songyun Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 以晉昌為盛京將軍，那清安署兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Jin Chang was made General of Mukden; Na Qing'an acted as Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Chang took Mukden and Na Qing'an acted for war.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以三載考績，予曹振鏞等議敘，罷侍郎那彥寶、善慶、吳芳培，降左都御史顧德慶。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, at the three-year performance review, Cao Zhengyong and others received graded rewards; Vice Ministers Na Yanbao, Shan Qing, and Wu Fangpei were dismissed; Left Censor-in-Chief Gu Deqing was demoted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the triennial review rewarded Cao Zhengyong and others and dismissed three vice ministers; Gu Deqing was demoted.

sentences.zh: 以王鼎為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wang Ding was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 命長齡回陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Chang Ling was ordered to return as Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling returned to Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 以松筠署直隸總督，那彥成署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Songyun acted as Zhili Governor-General; Na Yancheng acted as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun acted for Zhili and Na Yancheng for personnel.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，以謁陵命莊親王釂課等留京辦事。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: for tomb visits, Prince Zhuang Mianke and others were ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, dinghai, Prince Zhuang Mianke and others stayed in Beijing for tomb visits.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，兵部尚書戴聯奎卒，以王宗誠代之。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Minister of War Dai Liankui died; Wang Zongcheng succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Dai Liankui died and Wang Zongcheng took war.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，撥江蘇上元等二十州縣賑銀五十四萬兩。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu: 540,000 taels of relief silver were allocated to twenty Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingwu, 540,000 taels of relief silver went to twenty Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁東陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota taxes along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and cut route taxes by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上謁昭西陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵，詣端慧皇太子園寢奠酒。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor visited Zhaoxiling, Xiaodongling, Jingling, and Yuling, and offered wine at the garden tomb of the Crown Prince Duanhui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, the Emperor visited several eastern tombs and offered wine at Crown Prince Duanhui's garden tomb.

sentences.zh: 調穆克登額為禮部尚書，文孚為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Mukedenge was transferred to Minister of Rites; Wen Fu to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Mukedenge took rites and Wen Fu works.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上奉皇太后謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Western Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota taxes along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager west and cut route taxes by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以裕陵工程不慎，降莊親王釂課為郡王，解戴均元太子太保及管刑部，褫蘇楞額職，令在工次聽差，仍分成賠繳有差。

translations.literal: On day yimao, for negligence in the Yuling construction, Prince Zhuang Mianke was demoted to commandery prince; Dai Junyuan was stripped of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and supervision of Punishments; Suleng'e was dismissed and ordered to serve at the worksite, with proportional indemnities.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Yuling negligence cost Prince Zhuang his rank, Dai Junyuan his titles, and Suleng'e his post with indemnities.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 己未，清明節，上詣昌陵行敷土禮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Qingming: the Emperor went to Changling to perform the earth-spreading rite.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Qingming, the Emperor spread earth at Changling.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，上詣孝穆皇后殯宮前奠酒。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Emperor offered wine before the mourning palace of Empress Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Emperor offered wine at Empress Xiaomu's mourning palace.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: He escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 閏三月戊寅，穆克登布免理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Intercalary third month, day wuyin: Mukedengbu was dismissed as Minister of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month 3, wuyin, Mukedengbu left Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以禧恩為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Xi'en was made Minister of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Xi'en became Minister of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，賜戴蘭芬等二百二十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Dai Lanfen and 221 others were granted jinshi degrees with graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, 222 graduates including Dai Lanfen received jinshi rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩奉天寧遠等三州廳額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota taxes were remitted or deferred for three Fengtian prefectures including Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, taxes were remitted or deferred for three Fengtian prefectures including Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，上孝敬憲皇后、孝聖憲皇后、高宗純皇帝、孝賢純皇后、孝儀純皇后尊諡，藏冊寶于太廟、盛京太廟，並藏仁宗睿皇帝、孝淑睿皇后冊寶于盛京太廟。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinwei: posthumous honorifics were bestowed on Empresses Xiaojingxian, Xiaoshengxian, the Gaozong Emperor, Xiaoxianchun, and Xiaoyichun; books and seals were stored in the Imperial and Mukden Ancestral Temples, with those of Emperor Renzong and Empress Xiaoshu Rui stored in Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinwei, posthumous titles were given and books and seals stored in Beijing and Mukden temples.

sentences.zh: 壬午，青海番賊平。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Qinghai tribal rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Qinghai tribal rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 以阿霖為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: A Lin was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: A Lin became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以倉場侍郎莫晉奏事妄言，硃批駁斥，降內閣學士。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Granary Commissioner Mo Jin was rebuked in vermillion rescript for reckless memorializing and demoted to Grand Secretariat academician.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Mo Jin was rebuked and demoted from granary commissioner to academician.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩河南睢州等十六州廳縣沙壓、堤占、水占地賦，直隸滄州等五州縣並嚴鎮、海豐二場被水賦課。

translations.literal: That month, taxes on sand-silt, dike-occupied, and flood-submerged land were remitted or deferred for sixteen Henan prefectures including Suizhou; water-damaged levies in five Zhili prefectures and counties and two salt fields were likewise eased.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Henan and Zhili flood and sand-land taxes were remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑，大學士伯麟原品休致。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guichou: Grand Secretary Bo Lin retired at his original rank.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, guichou, Grand Secretary Bo Lin retired at original rank.

sentences.zh: 命戴均元仍管刑部。

translations.literal: Dai Junyuan was again ordered to supervise the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan again supervised Punishments.

sentences.zh: 己未，命那彥成署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Na Yancheng was ordered to act as Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Na Yancheng acted as Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 調嵩孚為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Song Fu was transferred to Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Song Fu became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 以羅含章為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Luo Hanzang was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Hanzang became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 以那清安署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an acted as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an acted for Punishments.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，褫松筠吏部尚書、軍機大臣，命以六部員外郎候補。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Songyun was stripped of Minister of Personnel and Grand Council membership and ordered to await assignment as a sixth-rank vice director.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Songyun lost personnel and Grand Council rank and awaited assignment as a vice director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命長齡為大學士兼管理籓院。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Changlin was ordered to serve as Grand Secretary and superintend the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Changlin became Grand Secretary and head of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以英和協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Yinghe was made associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghe became associate Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 調文孚為吏部尚書，禧恩為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Wen Fu was transferred to Minister of Personnel and Xi'en to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu took Personnel and Xi'en, Works.

sentences.zh: 以那清安為兵部尚書，玉麟為左都御史。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an was made Minister of War and Yulin Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an took War and Yulin the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以富俊為理籓院尚書，松箖為吉林將軍，德英阿為黑龍江將軍，英惠為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Fujun was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Songlin Jilin general, De Ying'a Heilongjiang general, and Yinghui Urumchi commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Fujun took Colonial Affairs; Songlin, Jilin; De Ying'a, Heilongjiang; Yinghui, Urumchi.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山西興縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in Xing County, Shanxi, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xing County, Shanxi, received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以程祖洛為河南巡撫，王鼎署之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month: Cheng Zuluo was made Henan governor and Wang Ding acted for him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, Cheng Zuluo became Henan governor with Wang Ding acting.

sentences.zh: 以程國仁為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Guoren was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Guoren became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸霸州等二十一州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in twenty-one Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, twenty-one Zhili districts including Bazhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，召雲貴總督史致光來京，以明山代之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guimao: Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Shi Zhiguang was recalled to the capital and Mingshan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, guimao, Shi Zhiguang left Yunnan-Guizhou and Mingshan replaced him.

sentences.zh: 河南新蔡縣教匪硃麻子作亂，命程祖洛捕誅之。

translations.literal: Sect bandit Zhu Mazai rebelled in Xin Cai County, Henan; Cheng Zuluo was ordered to capture and execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Mazai rebelled in Xin Cai, Henan, and Cheng Zuluo was told to capture him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，召慶保來京，以趙慎畛為閩浙總督，盧坤為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Qingbao was recalled; Zhao Shengzhen became Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Lu Kun Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Qingbao was recalled; Zhao Shengzhen took Fujian-Zhejiang and Lu Kun, Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以盧坤署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Lu Kun was ordered to act as Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Lu Kun acted as Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，賞廓爾喀國王寶石頂戴，噶箕畢穆興塔巴三品頂戴。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Gurkha king was granted a jeweled cap knob and Kaji Bimuxingtaba a third-rank cap knob.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Gurkha king received a jeweled cap knob and Kaji Bimuxingtaba, third rank.

sentences.zh: 辛未，召長齡、松廷來京，以那彥成署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Changlin and Songting were recalled; Nayancheng was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Changlin and Songting were recalled and Nayancheng acted at Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 是月，給河南安陽等三縣，直隸霸州等十二州縣，山西歸化城、薩拉齊二廳，山東恩縣等三縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for flood disaster in three Henan counties including Anyang, twelve Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou, two Shanxi banners of Guihua and Salaqi, and three Shandong counties including En County.
translations.idiomatic: That month, ration grain went to flooded districts in Henan, Zhili, Shanxi, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 貸土默特被水蒙古口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned to flooded Mongols of Tumet.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded Tumet Mongols received loaned ration grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩山東高唐等四十一州縣衛，雲南鶴慶、劍川二州災歉賦課。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for disaster and shortfall were remitted and deferred for forty-one Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Gaotang and for Heqing and Jianchuan in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-one Shandong districts including Gaotang and Heqing and Jianchuan in Yunnan lost disaster taxes, by degree.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申朔，允暹羅進本年例貢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day renshen: Siam was permitted to present this year's regular tribute.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, renshen, Siam could send this year's tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，撥通倉米十萬石賑直隸被水災民。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, 100,000 shi of grain from Tongcang was disbursed to relieve flood victims in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, 100,000 shi of Tongcang grain relieved Zhili flood victims.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，四川果洛克番賊平。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Golok Tibetans in Sichuan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Sichuan Golok bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 授嚴烺河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Yan Huang was appointed Eastern Rivers grain-transport governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Huang became Eastern Rivers grain-transport governor.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以蔣攸銛署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Jiang Youxian was ordered to act as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Jiang Youxian acted at Punishments.

sentences.zh: 調陳若霖為四川總督，李鴻賓為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Chen Ruolin was transferred to Sichuan governor-general and Li Hongbin to Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ruolin took Sichuan and Li Hongbin, Huguang.

sentences.zh: 以魏元煜為漕運總督，韓文綺為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Wei Yuanyu was made Grand Canal transport governor-general and Han Wenqi Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanyu took the Canal and Han Wenqi, Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 庚子，調盧坤為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Lu Kun was transferred to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Lu Kun became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以成格為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Chengge was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chengge became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江西瑞昌縣，河南武陟、原武二縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to disaster victims in Ruichang County, Jiangxi, and Wuzhi and Yuanwu in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ruichang in Jiangxi and Wuzhi and Yuanwu in Henan received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午謁陵，命莊親王釂課等留京辦事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: the Emperor visited the imperial tombs and ordered Prince Zhuang Mianké and others to remain in the capital to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, bingwu, the Emperor visited the tombs and left Prince Zhuang Mianké in charge at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 授那彥成陝甘總督，蔣攸銛刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was appointed Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general and Jiang Youxian Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng took Shaanxi-Gansu and Jiang Youxian, Punishments.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上以釋服奉皇太后謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day yimao, having ended mourning the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to visit the Western Tombs and remitted one-tenth of quota taxes along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, after ending mourning the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Western Tombs and remitted one-tenth of route taxes.

sentences.zh: 己未，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上謁昌陵行釋服禮。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor visited Changling and performed the mourning-release rite.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Emperor performed the mourning-release rite at Changling.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the court returned to Beijing with the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑甘肅河州、安徽宿州、直隸霸州等四十三州縣，江蘇海州、湖北天門二縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster was relieved in Hezhou, Gansu, Suzhou, Anhui, forty-three Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou, Haizhou in Jiangsu, and Tianmen in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood relief went to Hezhou, Suzhou, Bazhou, Haizhou, Tianmen, and other stricken districts.

sentences.zh: 貸給盛京廣甯縣，山東濮州等五州縣，黑龍江城庫木爾等二站水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned for flood disaster to Guangning County in Mukden, five Shandong prefectures and counties including Puzhou, and two Heilongjiang stations including Kumul.
translations.idiomatic: Loaned ration grain went to Mukden, Shandong, and Heilongjiang flood districts.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩甘肅靜寧等六州縣、河南儀封等二十三廳縣、湖北沔陽等十三州縣、山東濮州等五十一州縣衛、直隸通州等十八州縣、江蘇海州等三十四廳州縣衛被水災新舊額賦，墨爾根、布特哈舊欠糧石，長蘆及江蘇松江府屬正溢鹽課。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted and deferred for six Gansu prefectures and counties including Jingning, twenty-three Henan subprefectures and counties including Yifeng, thirteen Hubei prefectures and counties including Mianyang, fifty-one Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Puzhou, eighteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou, thirty-four Jiangsu subprefectures, prefectures, counties, and guards including Haizhou, owed grain for Mergen and Buteha, and regular and overflow salt levies for Changlu and Songjiang prefecture under Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Quota taxes were remitted or deferred across flooded Gansu, Henan, Hubei, Shandong, Zhili, and Jiangsu districts, with arrears forgiven for Mergen, Buteha, and selected salt fields.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛未朔，以玉麟署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon on day xinwei: Yulin was ordered to act as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: At the eleventh-month new moon, xinwei, Yulin acted at Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸未，撫恤廣東省城火災貧民蛋戶。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, poor boat households in Guangzhou were comforted after the city fire.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Guangzhou fire victims among poor boat people were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以玉麟為禮部尚書，慶保為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Yulin was made Minister of Rites and Qingbao Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Yulin took Rites and Qingbao, the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，立繼妃佟佳氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, secondary consort of the Niuhuru clan was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Consort Niuhuru became empress.

sentences.zh: 翌日，頒詔天下。

translations.literal: The next day, an edict was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, an edict went out to all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 覃恩有差。

translations.literal: Grace was extended in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: General grace was granted by degree.

sentences.zh: 戊子，起松筠為光祿寺少卿。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Songyun was recalled and made Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Songyun was recalled as Vice Director of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以冊立皇后禮成，上皇太后徽號曰恭慈康豫皇太后。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because the empress-installation rites were complete, the Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Empress Dowager Gongci Kangyu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, after the empress rites the Empress Dowager received the title Gongci Kangyu.

sentences.zh: 翌日，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: The next day an edict was promulgated throughout the realm and grace extended in differing degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The next day an empire-wide edict granted grace by degree.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽宿州等七州縣及屯坐各衛、河南武陟縣水災旱災，給安徽泗州等八州縣、甘肅河州等十一州廳縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, flood and drought disaster in seven Anhui prefectures and counties including Suzhou and garrison settlements, and flood disaster in Wuzhi, Henan, were relieved; ration grain was issued to disaster victims in eight Anhui prefectures and counties including Sizhou and eleven Gansu prefectures and subprefectures including Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Suzhou and other Anhui districts and Wuzhi in Henan received flood and drought relief, with ration grain for Sizhou and Hezhou areas.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩安徽宿州等十七州縣及屯坐各衛，河南武陟、陽武二縣，甘肅狄道等六州廳縣，江西南昌等七縣並南昌、九江二衛，湖南澧州、浙江海寧等四州縣被災新舊額賦，長蘆被水引地、兩淮板浦等九場被水新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted and deferred for seventeen Anhui prefectures and counties including Suzhou and garrison settlements, Wuzhi and Yangwu in Henan, six Gansu prefectures and subprefectures including Didao, seven Jiangxi counties including Nanchang and the Nanchang and Jiujiang guards, Lizhou in Hunan, and four prefectures and counties including Haining in Zhejiang; regular and overflow salt levies were also remitted for flooded Changlu salt fields and nine Lianghuai salterns including Banpu.
translations.idiomatic: Quota taxes were remitted or deferred in stricken Anhui, Henan, Gansu, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Zhejiang districts and at Changlu and Lianghuai salt fields.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingwu: the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, bingwu, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上以祈雪未應，命再禱七日。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because snow prayers had not been answered, a further seven days of prayer were ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, unanswered snow prayers brought orders for seven more days of prayer.

sentences.zh: 熱河都統成德卒，以慶保代之。

translations.literal: Rehe commandant Cheng De died and Qingbao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De of Rehe died and Qingbao succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 賞松筠二品頂戴為左都御史。

translations.literal: Songyun was granted a second-rank cap knob and made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun received a second-rank cap knob and became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 調程含章為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Hanzhang was transferred to Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Hanzhang became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 以陳中孚為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Chen Zhongfu was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Zhongfu became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，河南虞城縣匪徒盧照常等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, bandits Lu Changchang and others rebelled in Yucheng County, Henan, and were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lu Changchang and other bandits in Yucheng, Henan, were captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免江蘇、安徽嘉慶二十三年以前民欠攤徵銀。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, apportioned levy silver owed by the people of Jiangsu and Anhui before Jiaqing 23 was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Jiangsu and Anhui apportioned levies before Jiaqing 23 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 調德英阿為綏遠城將軍，祿成為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: De Ying'a was transferred to Suiyuan general and Lu Cheng Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: De Ying'a became Suiyuan general and Lu Cheng, Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，內閣漢票簽處火。

translations.literal: On day yichou, fire broke out in the Han memorial-drafting office of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Grand Secretariat Han drafting office burned.

sentences.zh: 是月，給直隸大城縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for flood disaster in Dacheng County, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dacheng in Zhili received flood ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸駐紮災區兵丁餉銀。

translations.literal: Relief silver for pay was loaned to garrison troops in stricken Zhili districts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili garrison troops in disaster areas received loaned pay silver.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸隆平等三縣、江蘇山陽等四縣水災旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for flood and drought disaster were remitted and deferred for three Zhili counties including Longping and four Jiangsu counties including Shanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Longping and other Zhili counties and Shanyang and other Jiangsu counties lost flood and drought taxes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、暹羅、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Siam, and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Siam, and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬申，禦重華宮，宴群臣及內廷翰林。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day renshen: the Emperor gave a banquet at Chonghua Palace for the court and Inner Palace academicians.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3, renshen, the Emperor feasted officials and academicians at Chonghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 調孫爾准為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Sun Erzhun was transferred to Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Erzhun became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 以陶澍為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Tao Shu was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Shu became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 以廓爾喀額爾德尼王遣噶箕達納彭咱邦禮等來賀登極進表貢，賜詔嘉勉，仍優賚之。

translations.literal: Because the Gurkha Erdini king sent Kaji Danapengzhabangli and others to congratulate the accession and present memorial and tribute, an edict praised and rewarded them generously.
translations.idiomatic: Gurkha envoys congratulating the accession were praised and richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幸圓明園。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Emperor went to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命大學士長齡在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Grand Secretary Changlin was ordered to serve on the Grand Council above the rank of Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Changlin was placed above ordinary Grand Councilors on the Council.

sentences.zh: 以史致光為左都御史。

translations.literal: Shi Zhiguang was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhiguang became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天小黑山白旗堡旗戶、直隸霸州等三十六州縣、江蘇海州水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster was relieved for banner households at Xiaoheishan White Banner Fort in Mukden and thirty-six Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou and Haizhou in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Mukden banner households and thirty-six Zhili and Jiangsu districts including Bazhou and Haizhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇邳州等八州縣衛水災、安徽宿州等十二州縣衛水災旱災、河南武陟縣水災、山東濮州等六州縣災民一月口糧。

translations.literal: One month's ration grain was issued for flood disaster in eight Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Pizhou, for flood and drought in twelve Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou, for flood in Wuzhi, Henan, and for disaster in six Shandong prefectures and counties including Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: One month's ration grain went to flooded Pizhou and other Jiangsu districts, stricken Anhui districts, Wuzhi in Henan, and Puzhou and other Shandong districts.

sentences.zh: 貸浙江海鹽、長興二縣旱災，陝西留壩等十一廳州縣雹災水災，甘肅靜寧等十七州縣地震災，兩淮板浦等九場水災，河南武陟等三縣，黑龍江齊齊哈爾、墨爾根城旗丁水災籽種糧石。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned for drought in Haiyan and Changxing in Zhejiang, hail and flood in eleven Shaanxi subprefectures and counties including Liuba, earthquake in seventeen Gansu prefectures and counties including Jingning, flood at nine Lianghuai salterns including Banpu, flood in three Henan counties including Wuzhi, and flood to banner soldiers at Qiqihar and Mergen in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Seed grain was loaned to drought, hail, flood, and earthquake districts in Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Gansu, Lianghuai, Henan, and Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑朔，命以原任大學士阿桂配饗太廟。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day xinchou: the former Grand Secretary Agui was ordered enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At the second-month new moon, xinchou, former Grand Secretary Agui was enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 調嵩孚為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Song Fu was transferred to Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Song Fu became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 以程國仁為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Guoren was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Guoren became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，釋奠先師孔子。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, sacrifice was offered to Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Emperor sacrificed to Confucius.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以原任尚書湯斌從祀文廟。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the former Minister Tang Bin was enshrined in the Confucius temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, former Minister Tang Bin entered the Confucius temple.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上詣文廟釋奠，臨辟雍講學，加禮部尚書汪廷珍太子太保銜。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Confucius temple, lectured at the Biyong, and granted Minister of Rites Wang Tingzhen the rank of Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Emperor sacrificed at the Confucius temple, lectured at the Biyong, and made Wang Tingzhen Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 是月，加給直隸大城縣口糧。

translations.literal: That month, additional ration grain was issued to Dacheng County, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dacheng in Zhili received additional ration grain.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，上御勤政殿聽政。

translations.literal: Third month, day renshen: the Emperor held court at the Hall of Diligent Government.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, renshen, the Emperor held court at the Hall of Diligent Government.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上親耕耤田，加一推。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor personally ploughed the sacred field, adding one furrow.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Emperor ploughed the sacred field with one extra furrow.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上奉皇太后幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 上行圍。

translations.literal: The Emperor went on the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor went on the autumn hunt.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Empress Dowager returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上奉皇太后閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to review Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Empress Dowager reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，調程含章為江西巡撫，以琦善署山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Cheng Hanzhang was transferred to Jiangxi governor and Qishan was ordered to act as Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Cheng Hanzhang took Jiangxi and Qishan acted at Shandong.

sentences.zh: 是月，加給直隸文安縣災民一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's additional ration grain was issued to disaster victims in Wen'an County, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wen'an in Zhili received an extra month's ration grain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，召顏檢來京，以蔣攸銛為直隸總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiachen: Yan Jian was recalled and Jiang Youxian made Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, jiachen, Yan Jian was recalled and Jiang Youxian took Zhili.

sentences.zh: 調那清安為刑部尚書，玉麟為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an was transferred to Minister of Punishments and Yulin to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an took Punishments and Yulin, War.

sentences.zh: 以戶部左侍郎穆克登額為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Left Vice Minister of Revenue Mukedengge was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Mukedengge of Revenue became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上禱雨於覺生寺。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor prayed for rain at Juesheng Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Emperor prayed for rain at Juesheng Temple.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜林召棠等二百四十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Lin Zhaotang and 246 others were granted jinshi and third-place honors with differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lin Zhaotang and 246 others received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，賑直隸霸州等州縣災。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinwei: disaster in Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, xinwei, Bazhou and other Zhili districts received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸霸州等三十六州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in thirty-six Zhili prefectures and counties including Bazhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, thirty-six Zhili districts including Bazhou received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 六月，命署工部侍郎張文浩會同蔣攸銛查勘南北運河並永定、大清、滹沱各河。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Acting Minister of Works Zhang Wenhao was ordered to join Jiang Youxian in surveying the Northern Grand Canal and the Yongding, Daqing, and Hutuo rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, Zhang Wenhao joined Jiang Youxian to survey the Northern Canal and major Hebei rivers.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以果勒豐額為烏裏雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Golefengge was made Uliastai general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Golefengge became Uliastai general.

sentences.zh: 永定河決。

translations.literal: The Yongding River burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding River burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，北運河決。

translations.literal: On day renxu, the Northern Grand Canal burst its banks.
