translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the Northern Grand Canal burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 是月，加給直隸靜海、青縣二縣災民兩月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, two months' additional ration grain was issued to disaster victims in Jinghai and Qing Counties, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jinghai and Qing in Zhili received two extra months' ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸河南汝陽、正陽二縣倉穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was loaned to Ruyang and Zhengyang counties in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Henan's Ruyang and Zhengyang received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，以陸以莊為左都御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen: Lu Yizhuang was appointed Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the seventh month, Lu Yizhuang became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以直隸霸州等十州縣被淹較重，飭撥銀米先行撫恤。

translations.literal: On day jisi, because Bazhou and nine other Zhili prefectures and counties were heavily flooded, silver and grain were ordered allocated for immediate relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, heavily flooded Bazhou and nine other Zhili districts received emergency silver and grain relief.

sentences.zh: 飭琦善撲蝗。

translations.literal: Qishan was ordered to exterminate locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan was ordered to fight locusts.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以江蘇水災，免各關商米稅銀。

translations.literal: On day renwu, because of Jiangsu floods, commercial-rice tax silver at all passes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Jiangsu flood relief remitted commercial-rice taxes at all passes.

sentences.zh: 免河南應攤川楚及衛案軍需四百六十萬兩。

translations.literal: Henan's assessed share of Sichuan-Hubei and guard-case military supplies, 4.6 million taels, was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Henan was exempted from 4.6 million taels of Sichuan-Hubei and guard military levies.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江西德化縣、湖北黃梅縣、江蘇太倉等十七州廳縣水災一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's rations were issued for flood victims in seventeen prefectures, departments, and counties including Dehua in Jiangxi, Huangmei in Hubei, and Taicang in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, one month's flood rations went to seventeen districts including Dehua, Huangmei, and Taicang.

sentences.zh: 加賑直隸通州等二十一州縣水災。

translations.literal: Additional relief was given for floods in twenty-one Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Extra flood relief reached twenty-one Zhili districts including Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，初舉經筵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai: the classics lecture was held for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the eighth month, the Emperor held his first classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以浙江杭州等三府屬水災，免海運商米船稅，並留各關稅銀備賑。

translations.literal: On day yimao, because of floods in three prefectures under Hangzhou, Zhejiang, sea-transport commercial-rice ship taxes were remitted and pass-tax silver was retained for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, Zhejiang flood relief remitted sea-transport rice taxes and held pass revenue for relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽無為等十六州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given in sixteen Anhui prefectures and counties including Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood relief reached sixteen Anhui districts including Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 給河南濬縣等十三縣水災一月口糧。

translations.literal: One month's rations were issued for floods in thirteen Henan counties including Jun County.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Henan counties including Jun received one month's flood rations.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，以謁陵命托津、英和、盧廕溥、汪廷珍留京辦事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: for tomb visitation Tuojin, Yinghe, Lu Yinpu, and Wang Tingzhen were left in the capital to manage affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the ninth month, Tuojin, Yinghe, Lu Yinpu, and Wang Tingzhen stayed in Beijing while the Emperor visited the tombs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，永定河決口合龍。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Yongding River breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, the Yongding River breach closed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上奉皇太后謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to worship at the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, he worshipped at the Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, he worshipped at Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，免直隸通州二十七州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, quota taxes were remitted for flood victims in twenty-seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, quota taxes were forgiven in twenty-seven flooded Zhili districts including Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 己丑，奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day jichou, he escorted the Empress Dowager back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, he brought the Empress Dowager back to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以松筠為吉林將軍，穆彰阿為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Songyun was made Jilin general and Muzhang'a Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Songyun became Jilin general and Muzhang'a Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸通州等四十州縣、山東臨清等五州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given in forty Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou and five Shandong prefectures and counties including Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood relief reached forty Zhili and five Shandong districts.

sentences.zh: 加賑江西德化縣、湖北黃梅縣、河南武陟等五縣水災。

translations.literal: Additional relief was given for floods in Dehua, Jiangxi, Huangmei, Hubei, and five Henan counties including Wuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Extra flood relief went to Dehua, Huangmei, and five Henan counties including Wuzhi.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇儀徵等四縣、湖北江陵等三縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: Flood rations were issued in four Jiangsu counties including Yizheng and three Hubei counties including Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Flood rations went to four Jiangsu and three Hubei counties.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩山東臨清等十六州縣衛、直隸薊州五十州縣水災新舊額賦，河南武陟縣、湖北黃梅縣水災額賦及屯坐各衛應徵新舊額賦，並給修屋費。

translations.literal: Quota taxes old and new were remitted and deferred for sixteen Shandong prefectures, departments, counties, and guards including Linqing and fifty Zhili prefectures and counties including Jizhou for floods; quota taxes and garrison-quota taxes old and new for Wuzhi, Henan, and Huangmei, Hubei, were remitted; house-repair funds were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Linqing and fifty other districts received tax remissions and house-repair funds for floods.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，賑湖北江陵等三縣衛水災，並免新舊額賦，給修屋費。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter: flood relief was given in three Hubei counties and guards including Jiangling; old and new quota taxes were remitted and house-repair funds issued.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Jiangling and two other districts received flood relief, tax remissions, and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 貸奉天錦州旗民、山東武城縣水災一月口糧，直隸天津鎮三營及紫荊關各汛被水兵丁銀米。

translations.literal: One month's rations were loaned to Banner people in Fengtian's Jinzhou and Wucheng, Shandong, for floods; silver and grain were loaned to flooded soldiers of three camps of Tianjin garrison and posts at Zijing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Jinzhou Banner people, Wucheng, and flooded Tianjin and Zijing Pass troops received rations and pay.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以毓岱為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yu Dai was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Yu Dai became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸甘肅靜寧等十六州縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, rations were loaned to victims in sixteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Jingning.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jingning and fifteen other Gansu districts received ration loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩湖南澧州等五州縣等水災，甘肅宜禾縣旱災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted and deferred for floods in five Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou and drought in Yihe, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Lizhou and four other Hunan districts and Yihe, Gansu, received tax deferrals for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以緝盜功，加陝西陝安道嚴如煜按察使銜。

translations.literal: On day guichou, for capturing bandits Yan Ruyu of Shaanxi Shaan'an Circuit received the acting censor-in-chief rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Yan Ruyu of Shaan'an received an acting censor rank for suppressing bandits.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇蘇州等五府駐紮災區兵丁銀米。

translations.literal: That month, silver and grain were loaned to troops stationed in disaster areas in five Jiangsu prefectures including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, troops in five Jiangsu flood districts received pay loans.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、緬甸來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Burma sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Burma paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬申，命停今歲木蘭秋獮。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, day renshen: this year's Mulan autumn hunt was ordered suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 4, on renshen, the Mulan autumn hunt was canceled.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，享太廟，命皇子奕緯代行禮。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Imperial Ancestors were sacrificed to; Prince Yichu was ordered to perform the rite in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, Prince Yichu sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors on the Emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 癸未，撥戶部銀八萬兩貸直隸貧民口糧。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, 80,000 taels from the Board of Revenue were allocated to loan rations to the poor in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, 80,000 taels were sent to loan Zhili poor rations.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸通州等三十八州縣上年雹災，河南武陟縣、濬縣旱災各一月。

translations.literal: That month, one month's relief was given for last year's hail in thirty-eight Zhili prefectures and counties including Tongzhou and one month for drought in Wuzhi and Jun, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Tongzhou and thirty-seven other districts received hail relief and Wuzhi and Jun drought relief for one month.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇太倉等三十州縣衛，安徽無為等十七州縣衛，浙江海寧等十二州縣、橫浦等四場，兩淮安豐等九場水災，山東臨清等五州縣雹災一月口糧。

translations.literal: One month's rations were issued for floods in thirty Jiangsu prefectures, departments, counties, and guards including Taicang, seventeen Anhui, twelve Zhejiang counties and four salterns including Haining, nine Huai'an salt fields, and hail in five Shandong counties including Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: One month's rations went to flooded and hail-hit districts across Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 貸河南武陟等十二縣上年水災籽種口糧倉穀，江西德化等十四縣、湖北黃梅等三縣及各屯衛、湖南澧州等四州縣、甘肅秦州等十州縣、齊齊哈爾等三城被災軍民籽種口糧，江蘇泰興營兵丁兩月錢糧。

translations.literal: Seed and ration grain were loaned from granaries for last year's floods in twelve Henan counties including Wuzhi, fourteen Jiangxi counties including Dehua, three Hubei counties including Huangmei and their garrison guards, four Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou, ten Gansu prefectures and counties including Qinzhou, three cities including Qiqihar, and two months' pay and grain to Taixing garrison troops, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Flood districts across several provinces received seed loans and Taixing troops two months' pay.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，召松筠為都察院左都御史。

translations.literal: Second month, day dingyou: Songyun was summoned as Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the second month, Songyun became Censorate Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 以富俊為吉林將軍，穆彰阿為理籓院尚書、軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Fujun was made Jilin general; Muzhang'a Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Fujun went to Jilin and Muzhang'a joined the Grand Council and Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 江南河道總督黎世序卒，以張文浩代之。

translations.literal: Jiangnan Canal governor-general Li Shixu died; Zhang Wenhao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixu died; Zhang Wenhao became Jiangnan canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禦經筵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor held classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上奉皇太后幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor took the Empress Dowager to the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上行圍。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor went on the hunt enclosure circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor went hunting.

sentences.zh: 己未，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor brought the Empress Dowager back from the park.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇銅山縣災民一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's rations were issued to disaster victims in Tongshan, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Tongshan received one month's rations.

sentences.zh: 調毓岱為江西巡撫，以康紹鏞為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Yu Dai was transferred to Jiangxi governor; Kang Shaoyong was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Dai went to Jiangxi and Kang Shaoyong to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 初彭齡罷，以陳若霖為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Chu Pengling was dismissed; Chen Ruolin was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chu Pengling left office and Chen Ruolin became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，貸湖北武昌府屬道士洑營、荊州城守等營兵丁倉穀，江南徐州鎮標中營等駐紮災區兩月錢糧。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renxu: granary grain was loaned to troops of Daoshifu camp under Wuchang, Jingzhou garrison, and other Hubei units; two months' pay and grain to disaster-zone troops of Xuzhou garrison mid-battalion, Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fourth month, Hubei and Jiangnan disaster troops received grain and two months' pay loans.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the fifth month, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雨。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 增致祭堂子禮。

translations.literal: Rites for sacrificing at the Tangzi altar were augmented.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices at the Tangzi altar were expanded.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，增皇太后萬壽告祭太廟後殿禮。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, rites for announcing sacrifice at the rear hall of the Imperial Ancestors on the Empress Dowager's longevity birthday were augmented.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, birthday announcement rites at the Imperial Ancestors rear hall were expanded.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳朔，日食。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day guisi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the sixth-month new moon, guisi, there was an eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以張師誠為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Zhang Shicheng was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Zhang Shicheng became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，暹羅國王鄭佛卒。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the king of Siam, Zheng Fo, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, King Zheng Fo of Siam died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，韓崶免，以陳若霖為刑部尚書，陸以莊為工部尚書，姚文田為左都御史。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingzi: Han Huan was dismissed; Chen Ruolin was made Minister of Punishments, Lu Yizhuang Minister of Works, and Yao Wentian Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the seventh month, Han Huan left; Chen Ruolin, Lu Yizhuang, and Yao Wentian took new posts.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大學士戴均元致仕。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Grand Secretary Dai Junyuan retired.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Dai Junyuan retired.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北衛昌、德安二營兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to troops of Weichang and De'an camps, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Weichang and De'an camp troops received grain loans.

sentences.zh: 閏七月辛丑，江蘇巡撫韓文綺降調，調張師誠為江蘇巡撫，以硃桂楨為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, day xinchou: Jiangsu governor Han Wenqi was demoted and transferred; Zhang Shicheng was transferred to Jiangsu governor; Zhu Guizhen was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the intercalary seventh month, Han Wenqi was demoted; Zhang Shicheng went to Jiangsu and Zhu Guizhen to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以韓克均兼署雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Han Kejun was made acting Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Han Kejun acted as Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命孫玉庭為大學士，以蔣攸銛為協辦大學士，均仍留總督任。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Sun Yuting was made grand secretary and Jiang Youxian assisting grand secretary; both retained their governor-general posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Sun Yuting and Jiang Youxian became grand secretaries but stayed governors-general.

sentences.zh: 成都將軍呢瑪善卒。

translations.literal: Chengdu general Nemashan died.
translations.idiomatic: Nemashan, Chengdu general, died.

sentences.zh: 以奕顥為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Yihuang was made Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: Yihuang became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以福釂為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Fuchao was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Fuchao became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免安徽無為等三十一州縣上年水災旱災額賦。

translations.literal: On day yimao, quota taxes were remitted for last year's flood and drought in thirty-one Anhui prefectures and counties including Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, thirty-one Anhui districts lost quota taxes for last year's flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江南二營銀米。

translations.literal: That month, silver and grain were loaned to two Jiangnan camps.
translations.idiomatic: That month, two Jiangnan camps received pay loans.

sentences.zh: 八月壬戌，命江蘇按察使林則徐濬浙江水道。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renxu: Jiangsu surveillance commissioner Lin Zexu was ordered to dredge Zhejiang waterways.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the eighth month, Lin Zexu was ordered to dredge Zhejiang waterways.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禦試翰林、詹事等官，擢硃方增五員一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor tested Hanlin and household officials; Zhu Fangzeng and five others were advanced to first rank, the rest promoted or demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Hanlin were tested; Zhu Fangzeng and five took first rank and others rose or fell.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，禦經筵。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor held classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以蘇明阿為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Suming'a was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Suming'a became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，予告大學士伯麟卒。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, retired Grand Secretary Bolin died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Bolin died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以成格為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Chengge was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Chengge became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩長蘆興國等七場、滄州等七州縣上年水災灶課，甘肅宜禾縣早災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, saltern duties were remitted and deferred for last year's floods at seven Changlu salterns including Xingguo and seven prefectures and counties including Cangzhou; quota taxes were remitted for drought in Yihe, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Changlu and Cangzhou salterns and Yihe received tax deferrals for flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，以黃鳴傑為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: Huang Mingjie was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the ninth month, Huang Mingjie became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，免安徽無為等十一州縣被災學田租銀。

translations.literal: On day guimao, school-field rent silver was remitted for disasters in eleven Anhui prefectures and counties including Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, eleven Anhui districts lost school-field rent for disaster.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西寧羌等四州縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, rations were issued to disaster victims in four Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Ningqiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Ningqiang and three other Shaanxi districts received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇瓜州營被災兵丁銀米，陝西安定等縣水災雹災倉穀。

translations.literal: Silver and grain were loaned to flooded troops of Guazhou camp, Jiangsu; granary grain for flood and hail in Anding and other Shaanxi counties.
translations.idiomatic: Guazhou troops and Anding and other Shaanxi counties received pay and grain loans.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，回酋張格爾入烏魯克卡倫，官軍失利，侍衛花山布等陣亡。

translations.literal: Tenth month of winter, day yichou: Muslim chieftain Zhang Ge'er entered the Wuleke pass; government troops were defeated; guards Huashanbu and others died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the tenth month, Zhang Ge'er took Wuleke pass; government troops were beaten and Huashanbu and others fell.

sentences.zh: 丙子，巴彥巴圖等率兵剿張格爾，敗之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Bayanbatu and others led troops against Zhang Ge'er and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Bayanbatu defeated Zhang Ge'er.

sentences.zh: 張格爾奔喀拉提錦。

translations.literal: Zhang Ge'er fled to Karatikin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ge'er fled toward Karatikin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，予告大學士章煦卒。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, retired Grand Secretary Zhang Xu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Zhang Xu died in retirement.

sentences.zh: 以孫玉庭奏開王營減水壩，命相機速辦。

translations.literal: Because Sun Yuting memorialized opening the Wangying flood-reduction dam, he was ordered to proceed at once as opportunity allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yuting's plan to open the Wangying dam was ordered carried out promptly.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，以高堰十三堡決口，張文浩交部嚴議。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiyou: because of the breach at thirteen forts of the Gaoyan embankment, Zhang Wenhao was referred to his ministry for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eleventh month, Zhang Wenhao was censured for the Gaoyan thirteen-fort breach.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命文孚、汪廷珍往江南查看高堰決口。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Wenfu and Wang Tingzhen were ordered to Jiangnan to inspect the Gaoyan breach.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Wenfu and Wang Tingzhen went to inspect the Gaoyan breach.

sentences.zh: 調嚴烺為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Yan Huang was transferred to Jiangnan canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Huang became Jiangnan canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以張井署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Zhang Jing acted as Hedong canal governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jing acted as Hedong canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，孫玉庭坐徇隱張文浩，免兩江總督，以魏元煜署。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Sun Yuting was dismissed as Liangjiang governor-general for shielding Zhang Wenhao; Wei Yuanyu acted in his place.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Sun Yuting lost Liangjiang for shielding Zhang Wenhao; Wei Yuanyu acted in his place.

sentences.zh: 命兵部尚書玉麟在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Minister of War Yulin was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: War Minister Yulin joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 是月，給安徽宿州、靈壁縣及屯坐各衛災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, rations were issued to disaster victims in Suzhou and Lingbi, Anhui, and garrison guards stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Suzhou, Lingbi, and local guards received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 貸江寧八旗、兩江督標協標兵丁餉銀，甘肅靜寧等十三州縣及東樂縣丞所屬災民口糧。

translations.literal: Pay silver was loaned to Jiangning Eight Banners and Liangjiang governor-garrison troops; rations were loaned to victims in thirteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Jingning and subjects of the Dongle assistant magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning and Liangjiang troops and thirteen Gansu districts including Jingning received loans.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未朔，上復詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day jiwei: the Emperor again went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: At the twelfth-month new moon, jiwei, the Emperor again prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，授魏元煜兩江總督，以顏檢為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Wei Yuanyu was appointed Liangjiang governor-general and Yan Jian made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Wei Yuanyu became Liangjiang governor and Yan Jian grain-transport governor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，召明山來京，以長齡為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Mingshan was summoned to the capital; Changling was made Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Mingshan was called to Beijing and Changling to Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 高堰決口合龍。

translations.literal: The Gaoyan breach was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Gaoyan breach closed.

sentences.zh: 以慶保為烏裏雅蘇台將軍，那清安為熱河都統，明山為刑部尚書，穆彰阿署。

translations.literal: Qingbao was made Uliassutai general; Na Qing'an Rehe military governor; Mingshan Minister of Punishments, with Muzhang'a acting.
translations.idiomatic: Qingbao went to Uliassutai, Na Qing'an to Rehe, Mingshan to Punishments, Muzhang'a acting.

sentences.zh: 是月，給雲南太和等三縣災民、景東廳屬鹽井灶戶一月口糧及修屋費，江蘇高郵等五州縣災民並清河廳災民一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's rations and house-repair funds were issued to victims in three Yunnan counties including Taihe and salt-well households in Jingdong; one month's rations to victims in five Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Gaoyou and Qinghe Department.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yunnan and Jiangsu disaster victims received rations and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，授戴三錫四川總督。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month: Dai Sanxi was appointed Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 5, Dai Sanxi became Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以三載考績，予托津、長齡、曹振鏞、黃鉞、英和、汪廷珍、蔣攸銛、那彥成、嚴烺議敘，加琦善總督銜。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, for three-year merit review Tuojin, Changling, Cao Zhenyong, Huang Yue, Yinghe, Wang Tingzhen, Jiang Youxian, Nayancheng, and Yan Huang were recorded for promotion; Qishan received governor rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, nine ministers were recorded for merit and Qishan gained governor rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇高郵等四州縣，安徽天長縣、泗州衛上年水災旱災軍民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was granted to military and civil people in four Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Gaoyou, and in Tianchang county, Anhui, and Sizhou Guard, for last year's flood and drought disasters.
translations.idiomatic: That month, last year's flood-and-drought rations went to Gaoyou and three other Jiangsu districts, Tianchang, and Sizhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸文安、大城二縣，河南汝陽、淮寧二縣，陝甘寧羌等七州縣，甘肅狄道等四十州廳縣及肅州州同、莊浪等縣丞所屬水災旱災雹災籽種口糧，兩淮中正場水災灶戶口糧，雲南景東廳被水鹽井修費，並免上年額課。

translations.literal: Seed grain and ration grain were loaned to Wen'an and Dacheng in Zhili, Ruyang and Huaining in Henan, seven prefectures and counties including Ningqiang in Shaanxi-Gansu, forty Gansu prefectures, departments, and counties including Didao and subordinates of the Sizhou sub-prefect and Zhuanglang assistant magistrates for flood, drought, and hail; ration grain to salt-field stove households at Liang-Huai Zhongzhen field; repair funds for flooded salt wells in Jingdong department, Yunnan; and last year's quota levies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Seed, rations, salt-field relief, and Yunnan salt-well funds were loaned or remitted across Zhili, Henan, Shaanxi-Gansu, Gansu, and Liang-Huai districts.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，禦經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day gengshen: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, gengshen, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以謁陵命莊親王、托津、盧廕溥、汪廷珍留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, for the tomb visit Prince Zhuang, Tuojin, Lu Yinpu, and Wang Tingzhen were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Prince Zhuang, Tuojin, Lu Yinpu, and Wang Tingzhen stayed in Beijing for the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上奉皇太后謁陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, paid rites at the tombs; one-third of quota levies in passed areas was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵，至寶華峪閱視萬年吉地，回鑾。

translations.literal: The Emperor paid rites at the Western Zhao Tombs, Xiaoling, Xiao East Tombs, Jing Tomb, and Yu Tomb, inspected the auspicious tomb site at Baohuayu, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor worshipped at the Western Zhao, Xiaoling, Xiao East, Jing, and Yu tombs, inspected Baohuayu, and returned.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, he visited the Southern Park for the battue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 是月，給安徽天長縣災民一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's ration grain was granted to disaster victims in Tianchang, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Tianchang received one month's disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，上還京師。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day wuzi: the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, wuzi new moon, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以琦善為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Qishan was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以程含章為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Cheng Hanzhang was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Cheng Hanzhang became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王鼎以一品銜署戶部左侍郎。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Wang Ding, with first-rank insignia, acted as left vice minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Wang Ding with first rank acted as left revenue vice minister.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免河南積年民欠並河工加價攤銀。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Henan accumulated civilian arrears and river-works surcharge instalments were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Henan civilian arrears and river surcharge instalments were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸寶坻、靜海二縣，甘肅洮州廳十七廳州縣及莊浪縣丞所屬災隸籽種口糧，齊齊哈爾被災旗人耕牛銀。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain and ration grain were loaned to Baodi and Jinghai in Zhili, seventeen Gansu departments and prefectures including Taozhou department and Zhuanglang subordinates, and plow-ox silver to disaster-hit banner people in Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhili, Gansu, and Qiqihar banner districts received seed, rations, or plow-ox relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑，免直隸積年逋賦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yichou: Zhili accumulated arrears were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, yichou, Zhili accumulated taxes were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以伊裏布為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yilibu was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yilibu became Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸駐紮歉區山西寧武等二營，湖北安陸等三營，荊州水師營、提標後營兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to garrison troops of two Shanxi battalions including Ningwu and three Hubei battalions including Anlu, and the Jingzhou naval camp and rear camp of the provincial standard.
translations.idiomatic: That month, granary grain was loaned to disaster-zone garrisons in Shanxi, Hubei, and Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，太監馬進喜以在滸墅關偽稱奉旨進香，交刑部治罪。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: eunuch Ma Jinxian, at Xushuguan falsely claiming an imperial order to offer incense, was handed to the Board of Punishments for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jiawu, eunuch Ma Jinxian was sent to the Board of Punishments for falsely claiming an imperial incense mission at Xushuguan.

sentences.zh: 諭各督撫，凡遇通緝太監，當認真緝捕。

translations.literal: Governors-general and governors were instructed: whenever wanted eunuchs appear, they must be diligently arrested.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered governors to arrest wanted eunuchs diligently.

sentences.zh: 有偽稱奉差者，迅即奏辦。

translations.literal: Those who falsely claimed to be on imperial errands were to be promptly memorialized for disposition.
translations.idiomatic: False imperial agents were to be reported at once.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，黃鉞以年老免軍機大臣，專辦部務，仍直南書房。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Huang Yue, on account of age, was dismissed from the Grand Council and assigned solely to ministry duties, while remaining on duty in the Southern Studios.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Huang Yue left the Grand Council for ministry work but stayed in the Southern Studios.

sentences.zh: 命王鼎在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Wang Ding was ordered to serve in the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 調張師誠為安徽巡撫，陶澍為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhang Shicheng was transferred to Anhui governor and Tao Zhu to Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shicheng took Anhui and Tao Zhu Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，孫玉庭、顏檢罷，調魏元煜為漕運總督，以琦善為兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Sun Yuting and Yan Jian were dismissed; Wei Yuanyu was made grain transport governor-general and Qishan Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Sun Yuting and Yan Jian fell; Wei Yuanyu took grain transport and Qishan Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 調伊裏布為山東巡撫，以鄂山為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Yilibu was transferred to Shandong governor and Eshan to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu went to Shandong and Eshan to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以本年漕運遲誤，諭切責孫玉庭等。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, because this year's grain transport was delayed, Sun Yuting and others were sharply rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, Sun Yuting and others were sharply rebuked for delayed grain transport.

sentences.zh: 玉庭交部嚴議，魏元煜、顏檢議處。

translations.literal: Yuting was referred to the ministry for severe discussion; Wei Yuanyu and Yan Jian were to be dealt with.
translations.idiomatic: Yuting faced severe ministry discipline; Wei Yuanyu and Yan Jian were also punished.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑貴州鎮遠府屬州縣水災，並免額賦，貸兵丁餉銀，給城衙修費。

translations.literal: That month, Zhenyuan prefecture and subordinate counties in Guizhou were relieved for flood, quota levies remitted, troop pay loaned, and yamen repair funds granted.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Guizhou's Zhenyuan area received flood relief, tax remission, troop loans, and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 貸湖北荊州駐守等四營駐紮災區兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was loaned to garrison troops of four Jingzhou-area camps in disaster zones in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou-area Hubei garrisons received disaster granary loans.

sentences.zh: 六月，命蔣攸銛為大學士，仍留直隸總督任。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Jiang Youshu was made grand secretary while remaining Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, Jiang Youshu became grand secretary and stayed Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以禮部尚書汪廷珍協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Wang Tingzhen was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Tingzhen was made associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，降魏元煜三品頂戴，仍留漕運總督任。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Wei Yuanyu was demoted to third-rank cap and still retained grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Wei Yuanyu lost his cap to third rank but kept grain transport.

sentences.zh: 孫玉庭、顏檢均交琦善督令挑濬運河，工費命玉庭、檢、元煜分償。

translations.literal: Sun Yuting and Yan Jian were both handed to Qishan to supervise dredging the Grand Canal; project costs were to be shared by Yuting, Jian, and Yuanyu.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yuting and Yan Jian dredged the canal under Qishan; all three shared the costs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏元煜卒，以理籓院尚書穆彰阿署漕運總督，前江甯將軍普恭署理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Wei Yuanyu died; Lifanyuan Minister Muzhanga acted as grain transport governor-general and former Jiangning general Pugong acted Lifanyuan minister.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Wei Yuanyu died; Muzhanga acted grain transport and Pugong Lifanyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以陶澍奏，停江南折漕，仍議河海並運。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, on Tao Zhu's memorial, Jiangnan converted grain tribute was halted and river-sea combined transport was again deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Tao Zhu's memorial halted Jiangnan converted tribute and revived joint river-sea transport plans.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸福建提標五營、泉州城守營穀價。

translations.literal: That month, grain prices were loaned to five Fujian camps including the provincial standard.
translations.idiomatic: That month, five Fujian garrisons received grain-price loans.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，以德英阿為烏裏雅蘇台將軍，和世泰為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei: Deying'a was made Uliastai general and Heshitai Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, dingwei, Deying'a took Uliastai and Heshitai Chahar.

sentences.zh: 是月，減免直隸等七州縣積水地額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota levies on waterlogged land were reduced for seven Zhili prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month, seven Zhili waterlogged districts lost quota tax by degree.

sentences.zh: 八月，以嵩孚為刑部尚書，調康紹鏞為湖南巡撫，以蘇成額為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Songfu was made Minister of Punishments; Kang Shaoyong was transferred to Hunan governor and Su Chenge to Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, Songfu took Punishments, Kang Shaoyong Hunan, and Su Chenge Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 己未，禦經筵。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 以陳中孚為漕運總督，調成格為廣東巡撫，以武隆阿為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Chen Zhongfu was made grain transport governor-general; Chengge was transferred to Guangdong governor and Wulong'a to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Chen Zhongfu took grain transport, Chengge Guangdong, and Wulong'a Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，召那彥成，以鄂山署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiyou: Nayancheng was summoned; Eshan acted Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, yiyou, Nayancheng was recalled and Eshan acted Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 調長齡為陝甘總督，趙慎畛為雲貴總督，以孫爾准為閩浙總督。

translations.literal: Changling was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, Zhao Shendian Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general, and Sun Erzhun Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Changling took Shaanxi-Gansu, Zhao Shendian Yunnan-Guizhou, and Sun Erzhun Fujian-Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 調韓克均為福建巡撫，以伊裏佈署雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Han Kejun was transferred to Fujian governor and Yilibu acted Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Han Kejun took Fujian and Yilibu acted Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 調武隆阿為山東巡撫，韓文綺為江蘇巡撫，以嵩溥為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Wulong'a was transferred to Shandong governor, Han Wenqi to Jiangsu governor, and Song Pu to Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wulong'a went to Shandong, Han Wenqi to Jiangsu, and Song Pu to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以張井為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Zhang Jing was made Hedong river course governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Zhang Jing became Hedong river governor-general.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以德英阿署伊犁將軍，松筠署烏裏雅蘇台將軍，普恭署左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Deying'a acted Ili general, Songyun acted Uliastai general, and Pugong acted left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Deying'a acted Ili, Songyun Uliastai, and Pugong the Censorate's left chief.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾幫辦大臣巴彥巴圖等率兵剿張格爾，妄殺布魯特部人。

translations.literal: Kashgar assisting ministers Bayanbatu and others led troops to suppress Zhang Ge'er and wantonly killed Barak tribal people.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar aides Bayanbatu and others suppressed Zhang Ge'er and killed Baraks wantonly.

sentences.zh: 其酋汰列克糾眾圍巴彥巴圖等於喀什噶爾，慶祥使穆克登布等援之。

translations.literal: Their chief Tielieke gathered a mob and besieged Bayanbatu and others at Kashgar; Qingxiang sent Mukedengbu and others to reinforce.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Tielieke besieged Bayanbatu at Kashgar and Qingxiang sent Mukedengbu to aid.

sentences.zh: 命慶祥緩來京。

translations.literal: Qingxiang was ordered to delay coming to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Qingxiang was told to delay his capital arrival.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西綏德等四州縣雹災。

translations.literal: That month, hail disaster in four Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Yuide was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, four Shaanxi districts including Yuide received hail relief.

sentences.zh: 蠲直隸開州等十五州縣旱災雹災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted for fifteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Kaizhou for drought and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen Zhili districts including Kaizhou lost drought-and-hail quota taxes.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，以長齡署伊犁將軍，楊遇春署陝甘總督，鄂山回陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengchen: Changling acted Ili general, Yang Yuchun acted Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general, and Eshan returned to Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, gengchen, Changling acted Ili, Yang Yuchun Shaanxi-Gansu, and Eshan returned to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 命德英阿赴烏裏雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Deying'a was ordered to proceed to Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: Deying'a was sent to Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 召松筠來京。

translations.literal: Songyun was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召蔣攸銛，以那彥成為直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Jiang Youshu was summoned and Nayancheng became Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Jiang Youshu was recalled and Nayancheng took Zhili.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西榆林等三縣雹災。

translations.literal: That month, hail disaster in three Shaanxi counties including Yulin was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three Shaanxi counties including Yulin received hail relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，以暹羅國貢船漂沒，詔免其補貢，封世子鄭福為暹羅國王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renchen: because Siam's tribute ship was wrecked, supplementary tribute was waived and the heir Zheng Fu was enfeoffed king of Siam.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, renchen, Siam's wrecked tribute ship spared a makeup mission and Zheng Fu became king.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免托津管刑部，以蔣攸銛代之，並命為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Tuojin was relieved of supervising Punishments; Jiang Youshu replaced him and was made a Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Tuojin left Punishments to Jiang Youshu, who also joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Dagao Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Shrine.

sentences.zh: 丙午，除直隸昌黎縣捍禦灤河地額賦。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, quota levies on Zhili Changli land defending the Luan River were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Changli's Luan River defense land lost quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丁未，雪。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, it snowed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, it snowed.

sentences.zh: 命慶祥以將軍銜署喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Qingxiang was ordered to act Kashgar councilor with the rank of general.
translations.idiomatic: Qingxiang was to act Kashgar councilor as a general.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以慶祥為喀什噶爾參贊大臣兼鑲黃旗漢軍都統，未任前，以穆克登佈署之。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Qingxiang was made Kashgar councilor and commanding general of the Bordered Yellow Banner Han Army; before taking office Mukedengbu would act.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Qingxiang became Kashgar councilor and Han Army commander; Mukedengbu acted until then.

sentences.zh: 授長齡伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Changling was appointed Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Changling became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑甘肅岷州等六州縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: That month, flood and hail in six Gansu prefectures and counties including Minzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, six Gansu districts including Minzhou received flood-and-hail relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳，免山東章丘、鄒平二縣被水逋賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: delinquent levies were remitted for flooded Zhangqiu and Zouping in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jisi, Zhangqiu and Zouping lost delinquent flood taxes.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，命科爾沁郡王僧格林沁御前行走。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, Prince Sengge Rinchen of Horqin was ordered to attend before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Prince Sengge Rinchen attended before the throne.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天錦州府旱災蟲災。

translations.literal: That month, drought and locust disaster in Fengtian's Jinzhou prefecture was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jinzhou in Fengtian received drought-and-locust relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、越南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月甲申，以雙城堡屯田，加富俊太子太保。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day jiashen: for Shuangchengpu colonization fields, Fujun was given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6, jiashen, Fujun received Grand Guardian for Shuangchengpu fields.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天錦州、中前所等處旗戶水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster to banner households in Jinzhou and Zhongqiansuo in Fengtian was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fengtian's Jinzhou and Zhongqiansuo banner flood victims were relieved.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇沛縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was granted to disaster victims in Pei county, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Pei county, Jiangsu, received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 貸奉天寧遠州旗民，河南鄢陵等七縣，甘肅岷州等十二州縣，山西襄垣縣，直隸寶坻等三縣水災旱災雹災籽種口糧倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain and ration grain and granary stocks were loaned to banner people in Ningyuanzhou, Fengtian, seven Henan counties including Yanling, twelve Gansu prefectures and counties including Minzhou, Xiangyuan county, Shanxi, and three Zhili counties including Baodi for flood, drought, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Seed, rations, and granary stocks were loaned across Fengtian, Henan, Gansu, Shanxi, and Zhili.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，以謁陵命托津、英和、汪廷珍、盧廕溥留京辦事。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuwu: for the tomb visit Tuojin, Yinghe, Wang Tingzhen, and Lu Yinpu were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, wuwu, Tuojin, Yinghe, Wang Tingzhen, and Lu Yinpu stayed in Beijing for the tombs.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，上謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, the Emperor paid rites at the Western Tombs; one-third of quota levies in passed areas was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, rites were paid at Tailing, Tai East Tombs, and Chang Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor worshipped at Tailing, Tai East, and Chang tombs.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，調張井為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: Zhang Jing was transferred to Jiangnan river course governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guisi, Zhang Jing became Jiangnan river governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，賞潘錫恩三品頂戴，為南河副總河。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Pan Xien was awarded a third-rank cap and made vice director-general of the Southern Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Pan Xien received a third-rank cap and became Southern Rivers vice director-general.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西靈丘縣、湖北荊州等五營被災兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to Lingqiu county, Shanxi, and five Jingzhou-area Hubei camps disaster-hit troops.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lingqiu and five Jingzhou camps received disaster granary loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，上詣黑龍潭神祠祈雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiazi: the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool Shrine.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, jiazi, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以鄧廷楨為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Deng Tingzhen was made Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Deng Tingzhen became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，賜硃昌頤等二百六十五人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Zhu Changyi and 265 others were granted jinshi with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Zhu Changyi and 265 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇沛縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was granted to disaster victims in Pei county, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Pei county again received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇徐州鎮三營，湖北德安、宜都二營災區兵丁錢穀。

translations.literal: Money and grain were loaned to three camps of Xuzhou garrison, Jiangsu, and two Hubei camps at De'an and Yidu in disaster zones.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster loans went to Xuzhou and De'an-Yidu garrisons.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，禮部尚書穆克登額免，以松筠代之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yimao: Minister of Rites Mukedeng'e was dismissed and Songyun replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, yimao, Mukedeng'e left Rites and Songyun replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以那清安為左都御史。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an was made left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以明山為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Mingshan was made Rehe commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Mingshan became Rehe commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雲貴總督趙慎畛卒，調阮元代之。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Zhao Shendian died; Ruan Yuan was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Zhao Shendian died and Ruan Yuan took Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 以嵩孚為湖廣總督，明山為刑部尚書，慶惠為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Songfu was made Huguang governor-general, Mingshan Minister of Punishments, and Qinghui Rehe commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Songfu took Huguang, Mingshan Punishments, and Qinghui Rehe.

sentences.zh: 壬寅。

translations.literal: On day renyin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day.

sentences.zh: 免直隸河間等五縣積水地畝逋賦。

translations.literal: Delinquent quota levies on waterlogged land in five Zhili counties including Hejian were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Five Zhili counties including Hejian lost waterlogged-land arrears.

sentences.zh: 是月，給山東堂邑等十二縣旱災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, drought rations for one month were granted to twelve Shandong counties including Tangyi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, twelve Shandong counties including Tangyi received one month's drought rations.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸廣平等五縣、山東堂邑等十二縣、河南臨漳等十二縣、山西隰州營口糧籽種倉穀。

translations.literal: Ration grain, seed grain, and granary stocks were loaned to five Zhili counties including Guangping, twelve Shandong counties including Tangyi, twelve Henan counties including Linzhang, and the Keluo battalion in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Seed, rations, and granary stocks were loaned across Zhili, Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 六月，賑湖北江陵、當陽二縣水災。

translations.literal: Sixth month: Jiangling and Dangyang in Hubei were relieved for flood.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, Jiangling and Dangyang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給河南臨漳等七縣旱災口糧。

translations.literal: Drought rations were granted to seven Henan counties including Linzhang.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Henan counties including Linzhang received drought rations.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸大名鎮標等七營被旱兵餉。

translations.literal: Drought-stricken troop pay was loaned to seven camps of Daming garrison standard, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Seven Zhili Daming camps received drought pay loans.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，張格爾糾安集延、布魯特回眾入卡。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: Zhang Ge'er roused Kokandians and Barak Muslims and entered the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, guisi, Zhang Ge'er led Kokandians and Baraks through the pass.

sentences.zh: 喀什噶爾回眾回應之。

translations.literal: Kashgar Muslims responded to him.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar Muslims rallied to him.

sentences.zh: 命楊遇春為欽差大臣剿之，鄂山署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Yang Yuchun was appointed Imperial Commissioner to suppress them; E Shan acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun became Imperial Commissioner to suppress the rebels; E Shan acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 命武隆阿為欽差大臣赴臺灣。

translations.literal: Wulong'a was appointed Imperial Commissioner to proceed to Taiwan.
translations.idiomatic: Wulong'a was made Imperial Commissioner for Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以德英阿為伊犁參贊大臣，倫布多爾濟署烏裏雅蘇台將軍，庚子，張格爾陷和闐城，領隊大臣奕湄、幫辦大臣桂斌等死之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Deying'a was made Ili Assistant Commissioner and Lunbudo'erji acted as Uliastai general; on day gengzi, Jahangir took Hotan, and expeditionary commissioner Yimei, assisting commissioner Guibin, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Deying'a became Ili assistant commissioner and Lunbudo'erji acted as Uliastai general; on gengzi day Jahangir took Hotan and Yimei, Guibin, and others fell.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命長齡為揚威將軍，以武隆阿為欽差大臣，與楊遇春參贊軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Chang Ling was made Campaigning General; Wulong'a was Imperial Commissioner, and with Yang Yuchun he was to assist military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Chang Ling became Campaigning General; Wulong'a was Imperial Commissioner with Yang Yuchun to assist the campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以德英阿署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Deying'a acted as Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Deying'a acted as Ili general.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇高郵等六州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for six Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangsu units including Gaoyou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給湖南醴陵等三州縣、山西歸化城水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued for flood victims in three Hunan prefectures and counties including Liling and at Guihua City, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Flood rations went to three Hunan units including Liling and to Guihua City in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 貸陝西西鄉、盩厔二縣水災籽種，奉天錦州府屬各驛馬乾銀。

translations.literal: Seed loans were made for flood disaster in Xixiang and Zhouzhi, Shaanxi, and fodder silver was issued for the posts under Fengtian's Jinzhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's Xixiang and Zhouzhi received seed loans, and Jinzhou posts received fodder silver.

sentences.zh: 八月，回酋巴布頂等陷英吉沙爾。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Muslim chiefs including Babuding took Yengisar.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Muslim chiefs including Babuding seized Yengisar.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，張格爾陷喀什噶爾城，參贊大臣慶祥、幫辦大臣舒爾哈善等死之。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Jahangir took Kashgar; Assistant Commissioner Qingxiang, assisting commissioner Shuerhashan, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Jahangir took Kashgar; Qingxiang, Shuerhashan, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 進陷葉爾羌，辦事大臣音登額、幫辦大臣多隆武等死之。

translations.literal: He advanced and took Yarkand; affairs commissioner Yindenge, assisting commissioner Duolongwu, and others died.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Yarkand; Yindenge, Duolongwu, and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇海州等五州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for five Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, five Jiangsu units including Haizhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給薩拉齊廳水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued for flood victims in Saragh banner.
translations.idiomatic: Saragh banner received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 貸山西綏遠城渾津黑河水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned for flood disaster at Hunjin Heihe, Suiyuan, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Flood rations were loaned at Hunjin Heihe in Shanxi's Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯朔，黃鉞免，以王鼎為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day yimao: Huang Yue was removed from office and Wang Ding was made Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, yimao, Huang Yue left office and Wang Ding took revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 命固原提督楊芳、甘肅提督齊慎赴阿克蘇軍營。

translations.literal: Guyuan Regional Commander Yang Fang and Gansu Regional Commander Qi Zhen were ordered to the Aksu army camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fang and Qi Zhen were ordered to the Aksu camp.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor returned to Yuanmingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, the Emperor returned to Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以博啟圖為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Boqitu was made Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Boqitu became Chahar commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，召穆彰阿來京，以楊懋恬署漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Muzhang'a was summoned to the capital and Yang Maotian acted as grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Muzhang'a was called to Beijing and Yang Maotian acted as grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以長清為阿克蘇辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Chang Qing was made Aksu affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Chang Qing became Aksu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己亥，慶廉奏敗賊于阿察他克台。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Qing Lian memorialized defeating rebels at Achataike.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Qing Lian reported a rebel defeat at Achataike.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，免阿克蘇附近回莊本年應交麥石。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, this year's wheat tribute due from Muslim villages near Aksu was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Aksu-area Muslim villages were exempted from this year's wheat tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，調格布舍為烏裏雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Gebushe was transferred to be Uliastai general.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Gebushe became Uliastai general.

sentences.zh: 是月，給貴州松桃廳，山西歸化廳，江蘇山陽、鹽城二縣，江西蓮花等七廳縣水災口糧銀穀。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain and silver were issued for flood victims in Guizhou's Songtao banner, Shanxi's Guihua banner, Jiangsu's Shanyang and Yancheng counties, and seven Jiangxi banners and counties including Lianhua.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood rations in grain and silver went to Songtao, Guihua, Shanyang, Yancheng, and seven Jiangxi units including Lianhua.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，贈喀什噶爾死事參贊大臣慶祥太子太保。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengshen: Qingxiang, Assistant Commissioner who died at Kashgar, was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In winter month 10, gengshen, martyr Qingxiang of Kashgar was posthumously made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，免兩淮富安等十四場水災灶課。

translations.literal: On day renxu, salt-field tax was remitted for fourteen Liang-Huai pans including Fu'an that suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, flood-struck Liang-Huai salt pans including Fu'an were forgiven salt tax.

sentences.zh: 甲子，撥江蘇籓關道庫銀一百四十五萬兩賑高郵等二十州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, 1,450,000 taels from the Jiangsu provincial treasury were allocated for flood relief in twenty prefectures and counties including Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, 1.45 million taels from Jiangsu funds relieved floods in twenty units including Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 是月，給安徽宿州等八州縣衛被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for victims in eight Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, eight Anhui units including Suzhou received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇高郵等四十七州廳縣衛災民新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for disaster victims in forty-seven Jiangsu prefectures, banners, counties, and guards including Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-seven Jiangsu units including Gaoyou had old and new quotas remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，長齡等奏敗賊于阿克蘇之柯爾坪。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: Chang Ling and others memorialized defeating rebels at Korla in Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuzi, Chang Ling reported defeating rebels at Korla near Aksu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以臺灣平，加孫爾准太子少保。

translations.literal: On day jichou, because Taiwan was pacified, Sun Erzhun was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, with Taiwan pacified, Sun Erzhun became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑湖南茶陵等三州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for disaster victims in three Hunan prefectures and counties including Chaling.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three Hunan units including Chaling received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅秦州等十三州縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned for disaster victims in thirteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen Gansu units including Qinzhou received ration loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩盛京牛莊等處水災糧租，湖南茶陵等五州縣水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Grain rent was remitted or deferred for flood at Shenyang's Niuzhuang and elsewhere, and old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for flood in five Hunan prefectures and counties including Chaling.
translations.idiomatic: Niuzhuang and other Shenyang flood rents were eased, and five Hunan units including Chaling had quotas remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申朔，以楊健為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day wushen: Yang Jian was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: At the twelfth-month new moon, wushen, Yang Jian became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 以訥爾經額為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Na'erjing'e was made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Na'erjing'e became grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，四子部扎薩克親王伊什楚克魯布以僭妄削爵。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Ishchukurub, zhasake prince of the Four Sons Department, was stripped of rank for presumption.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Ishchukurub, a zhasake prince of the Four Sons, lost his title for presumption.

sentences.zh: 戊午，調英和為理籓院尚書，禧恩為戶部尚書，穆彰阿為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yinghe was transferred to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Xi'en to Minister of Revenue, and Muzhang'a to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yinghe took colonial affairs, Xi'en revenue, and Muzhang'a works.

sentences.zh: 是歲，琉球、朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu and Korea paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丁酉，和闐回眾降，命優賚之。

translations.literal: Year 7, spring, first month, day dingyou: the Muslims of Hotan surrendered and were ordered specially rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7, spring month 1, dingyou, Hotan Muslims surrendered and were ordered favored rewards.

sentences.zh: 尋復為張格爾所陷。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they were again taken by Jahangir.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jahangir seized them again.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以惠顯為駐藏辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Huixian was made resident commissioner in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Huixian became Tibet commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，展賑江蘇高郵等二十三州縣衛軍民、兩淮丁谿等九場灶戶水災。

translations.literal: That month, extended flood relief was given for military and civilian victims in twenty-three Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Gaoyou, and for salt households at nine Liang-Huai pans including Dingxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, extended flood relief went to twenty-three Jiangsu units including Gaoyou and nine Liang-Huai salt pans including Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 給安徽泗州、五河縣及屯坐各衛，奉天白旗堡、小黑山二處災歉口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued for victims in Anhui's Sizhou and Wuhe counties and garrison settlements, and at Fengtian's Baqi Fort and Xiaoheishan.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhou, Wuhe, garrison settlements, Baqi Fort, and Xiaoheishan received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸開州等十州縣、甘肅秦州等十七州廳縣、河南原武等四縣、兩淮富安等五場、江西蓮花等五廳縣災歉口糧籽種，河南修武、封丘二縣，山西薩拉齊廳災民倉穀，江蘇川沙廳等三營、青村等八營銀米。

translations.literal: Ration grain and seed were loaned for disaster and poor harvest in ten Zhili prefectures and counties including Kaizhou, seventeen Gansu prefectures and counties including Qinzhou, four Henan counties including Yuanwu, five Liang-Huai salt pans including Fu'an, and five Jiangxi banners and counties including Lianhua; granary grain for victims in Henan's Xiuwu and Fengqiu counties and Shanxi's Saragh banner; and silver and grain for three Jiangsu garrisons including Chuansha and eight garrisons including Qingcun.
translations.idiomatic: Kaizhou and nine other Zhili units, seventeen Gansu units including Qinzhou, four Henan counties, five Liang-Huai pans, five Jiangxi units, Xiuwu and Fengqiu, Saragh, and eleven Jiangsu garrisons received ration, seed, or granary aid.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiaxu, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇狼山等三營毗連災區兵餉。

translations.literal: That month, military pay was loaned to three Jiangsu garrisons including Langshan that bordered disaster areas.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three Jiangsu garrisons including Langshan received pay loans near flooded districts.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，賑江蘇高郵等州縣水災。

translations.literal: Third month, day jichou: flood relief was given for Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jichou, Jiangsu units including Gaoyou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，長齡等奏敗賊于洋阿爾巴特。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Chang Ling and others memorialized defeating rebels at Yang'arbart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Chang Ling reported defeating rebels at Yang'arbart.

sentences.zh: 晉長齡太子太保。

translations.literal: Chang Ling was advanced to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling became Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 己亥，長齡等敗賊于沙布都爾，獲安集延回目色提巴爾第。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Chang Ling and others defeated rebels at Shabudur and captured the Kokand Muslim headman Setiba'erdi.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Chang Ling defeated rebels at Shabudur and captured the Kokand notable Setiba'erdi.

sentences.zh: 命蔣攸銛、穆彰阿查勘南河。

translations.literal: Jiang Youxian and Muzhang'a were ordered to inspect the Southern Canal.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Youxian and Muzhang'a were told to survey the Southern Canal.

sentences.zh: 以那清安署工部尚書。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an acted as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an acted as works minister.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以惠顯為駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Huixian was made resident minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Huixian became Tibet commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，雨。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, it rained.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇高郵等州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Gaoyou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangsu units including Gaoyou received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅張掖等三縣、直隸開州等六州縣貧民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned to the poor in three Gansu counties including Zhangye and six Zhili prefectures and counties including Kaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangye and two other Gansu counties and six Zhili units including Kaizhou received ration loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，日食。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on day bingwu: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer month 4, bingwu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊申，長齡等奏敗賊于阿克瓦巴特。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Chang Ling and others memorialized defeating rebels at Akwabart.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Chang Ling reported defeating rebels at Akwabart.

sentences.zh: 予長齡紫韁，加楊遇春太子太傅，武隆阿太子少保。

translations.literal: Chang Ling was granted purple reins; Yang Yuchun was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and Wulong'a Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ling received purple reins; Yang Yuchun became Grand Tutor and Wulong'a Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬子，長齡等克喀什噶爾，張格爾遁。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Chang Ling and others took Kashgar and Jahangir fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Kashgar was recovered and Jahangir escaped.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，進克英吉沙爾。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, they advanced and took Yengisar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Yengisar was recovered.

sentences.zh: 以張格爾未獲，褫長齡紫韁、楊遇春太子太傅、武隆阿太子少保。

translations.literal: Because Jahangir had not been captured, Chang Ling's purple reins and the ranks of Yang Yuchun and Wulong'a were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: With Jahangir still at large, Chang Ling lost his purple reins and Yang Yuchun and Wulong'a lost their honors.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，楊芳克和闐，獲回目噶爾勒等，誅之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengchen: Yang Fang took Hotan, captured the Muslim headmen including Ga'erle, and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, gengchen, Yang Fang recovered Hotan, seized Ga'erle and other Muslim leaders, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，陸以莊免，以王引之為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Lu Yizhuang was removed from office and Wang Yinzhi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Lu Yizhuang left office and Wang Yinzhi took works.

sentences.zh: 癸未，琦善、張井、潘錫恩嚴議。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Qi Shan, Zhang Jing, and Pan Xi'en were severely reprimanded.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Qi Shan, Zhang Jing, and Pan Xi'en were sharply rebuked.

sentences.zh: 琦善免兩江總督，以蔣攸銛代之。

translations.literal: Qi Shan was removed as Liangjiang governor-general and Jiang Youxian replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Shan left the Liangjiang post and Jiang Youxian replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以托津管刑部。

translations.literal: Tuojin was placed in charge of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Tuojin took charge of punishments.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命穆彰阿在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Muzhang'a was ordered to study and serve under the Grand Council ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Muzhang'a was told to study under the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 閏五月乙巳朔，免回疆八城新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Intercalary fifth month, new moon on day yisi: old and new quota taxes for the eight Muslim cities were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: At the intercalary fifth-month new moon, yisi, quotas for the eight border cities were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命楊遇春回，以楊芳為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Yang Yuchun was ordered to return and Yang Fang was made Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Yang Yuchun was recalled and Yang Fang became assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊申，調奕顥為盛京將軍，晉昌為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Yihao was transferred to Shenyang general and Jin Chang to Suiyuan general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Yihao became Shenyang general and Jin Chang Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北黃州協道士洑營兵丁穀石。

translations.literal: That month, grain was loaned to soldiers at the Huangzhou garrison post at Daoshifu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huangzhou post soldiers at Daoshifu received grain loans.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renwu: the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, renwu, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，雨。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, it rained.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，協辦大學士、禮部尚書汪廷珍卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: Associate Grand Secretary and Minister of Rites Wang Tingzhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn month 7, renzi, Associate Grand Secretary Wang Tingzhen died.

sentences.zh: 晉昌免正黃旗領侍衛內大臣，以鄭親王烏爾恭阿代之。

translations.literal: Jin Chang was removed as inner palace guard of the Plain Yellow Banner and Prince Zheng Urgung'a replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Chang left the Plain Yellow guard post and Prince Zheng Urgung'a replaced him.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以姚文田為禮部尚書，湯金釗為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Yao Wentian was made Minister of Rites and Tang Jinzhao Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Yao Wentian took rites and Tang Jinzhao the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命盧廕溥協辦大學士。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Lu Yinpu was appointed Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Lu Yinpu became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 己未，英和以失察家丁，褫協辦大學士、理籓院尚書、紫韁。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Yinghe, for failing to control household servants, was stripped of Associate Grand Secretary, Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, and purple reins.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yinghe lost associate grand secretary, colonial affairs, and purple reins for lax control of servants.

sentences.zh: 召富俊為理籓院尚書、協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Fujun was summoned as Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Associate Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Fujun was called to colonial affairs and associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 以博啟圖為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Boqitu was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: Boqitu became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 以安福為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Anfu was made Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Anfu became Chahar commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，熱河都統升寅免，以那清安代之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Rehe commandant Sheng Yin was removed and Na Qing'an replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Sheng Yin left Rehe and Na Qing'an replaced him.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，那清安仍為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Na Qing'an again became Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Na Qing'an returned as left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 英和褫太子太保，降二品頂戴，為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Yinghe was stripped of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, reduced to second-rank cap insignia, and made Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghe lost Grand Guardian rank, was reduced to second-rank insignia, and became Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以武隆阿為喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Wulong'a was made Kashgar Assistant Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Wulong'a became Kashgar assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以盧坤為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Lu Kun was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun became Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，免甘肅兵差過境之各州縣額賦，協濟軍需之甘肅、陝西各州縣額賦十分之六。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, quota taxes were remitted for Gansu prefectures and counties through which troops passed, and sixty percent of quota taxes were remitted for Gansu and Shaanxi prefectures and counties that aided military supplies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Gansu transit taxes were forgiven and Gansu and Shaanxi military-aid counties lost sixty percent of quotas.

sentences.zh: 庚午，論喀什噶爾等四城收復功，復楊遇春太子太保，加鄂山、盧坤太子少保。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, discussing merit in recovering Kashgar and three other cities, Yang Yuchun was again made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and E Shan and Lu Kun were made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, for recovering four cities, Yang Yuchun regained Grand Guardian rank and E Shan and Lu Kun became Junior Guardians.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以再定回疆，晉曹振鏞太子太師，蔣攸銛、文孚太子太保，加王鼎、玉麟太子少保。

translations.literal: On day renshen, because the Muslim borderlands were secured again, Cao Zhenyong was advanced to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, Jiang Youxian and Wen Fu to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and Wang Ding and Yu Lin to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, with the borderlands secured again, Cao Zhenyong became Grand Preceptor, Jiang Youxian and Wen Fu Grand Guardians, and Wang Ding and Yu Lin Junior Guardians.

sentences.zh: 是月，給奉天錦州等三府州縣水災旗民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for banner people in three Fengtian prefectures and counties including Jinzhou who suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood rations went to three Fengtian units including Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，萬壽節，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiwei: on the Longevity Festival, banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, guiwei, Longevity Festival banquets were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，調盧坤為山西巡撫，以琦善為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Lu Kun was transferred to Shanxi governor and Qi Shan was made Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Lu Kun went to Shanxi and Qi Shan to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西略陽縣，湖北江陵、監利二縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for Shaanxi's Lueyang county and Hubei's Jiangling and Jianli counties.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lueyang, Jiangling, and Jianli received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給江淮等處被災幫丁月糧。

translations.literal: Monthly rations were issued for canal laborers harmed by disaster in the Jiang-Huai region and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster-hit canal laborers in the Jiang-Huai region received monthly rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇高郵等四十七州縣衛廳被水新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for forty-seven Jiangsu prefectures, counties, guards, and banners flooded by water.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-seven flooded Jiangsu units had old and new quotas remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，以孝穆皇后梓宮移寶華峪，命皇長子奕緯祖奠。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guichou: because Empress Xiaomu's coffin was moved to Baohua Valley, the eldest son Yiwei was ordered to perform the ancestral offering rites.
