translations.idiomatic: In month 9, guichou, Empress Xiaomu's coffin went to Baohua Valley and eldest son Yiwei was ordered to lead the ancestral rites.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上詣孝穆皇后梓宮前奠酒。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the Emperor went to offer libation before the coffin palace of Empress Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, the Emperor offered wine before Empress Xiaomu's coffin palace.

sentences.zh: 授伊裏布雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Yilibu was appointed governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 戊午，免兵差過境之陝西華州等二十二州廳縣額賦十分之六。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, six-tenths of quota levies were remitted for twenty-two prefectures, departments, and counties of Shaanxi including Huazhou through which troops passed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, six-tenths of quota levies were remitted for twenty-two Shaanxi districts on the troop route.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上謁東陵，免經過地方本年額賦十分之五。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted five-tenths of this year's quota levies on places the route passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs with five-tenths tax relief on the route.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵。

translations.literal: On day guihai, he visited Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, Jingling, and Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, he visited Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, Jingling, and Yuling.

sentences.zh: 召長齡，以德英阿為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Changling was summoned; Deying'a was made Ili General.
translations.idiomatic: Changling was recalled and Deying'a became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 晉戴均元太子太師。

translations.literal: Dai Junyuan was promoted to Grand Preceptor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan was made grand preceptor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是日，回鑾。

translations.literal: That day, the imperial procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: That day the Emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以楊國楨為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yang Guozhen was made governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yang Guozhen became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 免兵差過境之盛京省城及所屬開原等十四處旗民額賦十分之四。

translations.literal: Four-tenths of quota levies for Banner households were remitted at the Shengjing capital and fourteen attached places including Kaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Four-tenths of Banner quota levies were remitted at Shengjing and fourteen attached districts.

sentences.zh: 是月，加賑陝西略陽縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, extra relief was given for the flood disaster in Lueyang county, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month extra flood relief went to Lueyang in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，免嘉慶二十五年至道光五年各省民欠正雜錢糧。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengchen: principal and miscellaneous grain and money arrears owed by the people of each province from the twenty-fifth year of Jiaqing through the fifth year of Daoguang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on gengchen day, provincial grain and money arrears from Jiaqing 25 through Daoguang 5 were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇太后萬壽聖節，奉懿旨停筵宴。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Empress Dowager's longevity birthday: by edict of the Empress Dowager, banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Empress Dowager's birthday; per her edict, feasts were stopped.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，禮部尚書姚文田卒，以湯金釗代之。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Minister of Rites Yao Wentian died; Tang Jinzhuan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Yao Wentian died and Tang Jinzhuan took the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 以潘世恩為都察院左都御史。

translations.literal: Pan Shien was made Left Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Shien became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，巴繃阿免，以額勒津為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Babeng'a was dismissed; Elerjin was made consultant minister at Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Babeng'a was dismissed and Elerjin became Kobdo consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以綸布多爾濟為庫倫蒙古辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Lunbudu'erji was made Mongol commissioner at Kulun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Lunbudu'erji became Kulun Mongol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑湖北江陵、監利二縣及屯坐各衛水災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for flood disasters in Jiangling and Jianli counties, Hubei, and garrison settlements of each guard.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief went to Jiangling, Jianli, and attached garrison settlements in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 給奉天廣甯縣被水站丁口糧。

translations.literal: Grain was given to station households flooded at Guangning county, Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Flood-struck station households at Guangning in Fengtian received grain.

sentences.zh: 貸山西定襄、潞城二縣旱災雹災倉穀，黑龍江墨爾根城歉收口糧。

translations.literal: Stored grain was loaned for drought and hail disasters in Dingxiang and Lucheng counties, Shanxi, and for short rations at Moergen city, Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi drought and hail districts and Moergen in Heilongjiang received loaned grain.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，命長齡督同楊芳辦理回疆善後事宜。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yisi: Changling was ordered to supervise, together with Yang Fang, the settlement of affairs after the pacification of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yisi day, Changling and Yang Fang were ordered to settle Xinjiang affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙午，召那彥成。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Nayancheng was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Nayancheng was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，授那彥成欽差大臣，會同長齡籌辦回疆善後事宜。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Nayancheng was appointed Imperial Commissioner to join Changling in planning the settlement of affairs after the pacification of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Nayancheng became imperial commissioner with Changling for Xinjiang settlement.

sentences.zh: 以屠之申署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Tu Zhishen was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Zhishen acted as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免奉天遼陽等七州廳縣地丁銀十分之四。

translations.literal: On day jisi, four-tenths of land-and-service silver levies were remitted for seven prefectures, departments, and counties of Fengtian including Liaoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, four-tenths of land tax was remitted for seven Fengtian districts including Liaoyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑甘肅岷州等六州縣水災雹災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for flood and hail disasters in six prefectures and counties of Gansu including Minzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood and hail relief went to six Gansu districts including Minzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以彥德為烏裏雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Yande was made general at Uliasutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Yande became Uliasutai general.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丙午，以松筠署熱河都統，那清安署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, day bingwu: Songyun was ordered to act as Rehe commander; Na Qing'an was ordered to act as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8, on first-month bingwu day, Songyun acted at Rehe and Na Qing'an at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 戊申，授劉彬士浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Liu Binshi was appointed governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Liu Binshi became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，長齡奏獲張格爾。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Changling memorialized that Jahangir had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Changling reported the capture of Jahangir.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，封長齡威勇公，授御前大臣。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Changling was enfeoffed as Duke of Weiyong and made an imperial presence minister.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, Changling became Duke of Weiyong and an imperial presence minister.

sentences.zh: 封楊芳果勇侯。

translations.literal: Yang Fang was enfeoffed as Marquis of Guoyong.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fang was made Marquis of Guoyong.

sentences.zh: 調果齊斯歡為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Guoqisihuan was transferred to be general at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Guoqisihuan became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，晉曹振鏞太傅，文孚太子太傅，玉麟太子太保。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Cao Zhenyong was promoted to Grand Tutor; Wen Fu to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Yu Lin to Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Cao Zhenyong became grand tutor, Wen Fu grand tutor of the crown prince, and Yu Lin grand guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 加穆彰阿太子少保，並充軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Mu Zhang'a was made Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince and also appointed to the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Zhang'a became junior guardian of the crown prince and joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 授楊遇春陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Yang Yuchun was appointed Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，晉將攸銛太子太傅。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Prince Yonghuai was promoted to Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Prince Yonghuai became grand tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 復英和太子太保。

translations.literal: Ying He was restored to Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Ying He was restored as grand guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 命那彥成仍以欽差大臣赴喀什噶爾，偕楊芳辦善後。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was ordered to proceed still as Imperial Commissioner to Kashgar and, together with Yang Fang, settle the aftermath.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng was still sent as imperial commissioner to Kashgar with Yang Fang to settle affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加禧恩太子少保。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Xi'en was made Junior Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Xi'en became junior guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇沛縣貧民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, grain rations were given to poor people of Peixian county, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month poor people in Jiangsu Peixian received grain.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸滄州等九州縣災歉口糧，湖北江陵、監利二縣及屯坐各衛籽種，山西定襄等四縣倉穀，江蘇江寧、京口駐防修屋費。

translations.literal: Grain rations were loaned for disaster and shortage in nine prefectures and counties of Zhili including Cangzhou; seed grain was loaned to Jiangling and Jianli counties of Hubei and garrison settlements of each guard; stored grain was loaned in four counties of Shanxi including Dingxiang; and funds were loaned for repairing quarters of garrisons at Jiangning and Jingkou, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster rations were loaned in Zhili, seed in Hubei garrisons, grain in Shanxi, and repair funds for Jiangsu garrisons.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，群臣以再定回疆，上尊號，卻之，命議上皇太后徽號。

translations.literal: Second month, day yihai: the ministers, because the Western Regions had been pacified again, proposed an honorific title for the Emperor; he declined and ordered discussion of an honorific title for the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On second-month yihai day, ministers proposed an imperial honorific for reconquering Xinjiang; the Emperor refused and ordered an empress dowager honorific instead.

sentences.zh: 都察院左都御史史致光卒。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Shi Zhiguang died.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhiguang, left censor-in-chief, died.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子朔，日食。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day gengzi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on the new moon, gengzi day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上行圍，至丁巳皆如之。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor went on the enclosure hunt; from yisi through dingwei he did the same each day.
translations.idiomatic: From yisi through dingwei the Emperor hunted in the enclosure each day.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上還宮。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Emperor returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸開州等六州縣貧民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, grain rations were loaned to poor people in six prefectures and counties of Zhili including Kaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month poor people in six Zhili districts including Kaizhou received loaned grain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，調果齊斯歡為黑龍江將軍，以特依順保為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Guoqisihuan was transferred to be general at Heilongjiang; Te Yishunbao was made general at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, Guoqisihuan took Heilongjiang and Te Yishunbao took Suiyuan.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西代州等二十四州縣歉收、湖北駐兵災區、荊州水師各營倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, stored grain was loaned for poor harvest in twenty-four prefectures and counties of Shanxi including Daizhou, for disaster areas of garrison troops in Hubei, and for the grain stores of camps of the Jingzhou naval command.
translations.idiomatic: That month grain was loaned in twenty-four Shanxi districts, Hubei garrison disaster areas, and Jingzhou naval camps.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，以獲張格爾，遣官告祭太廟、社稷，行獻俘禮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiyou: because Jahangir had been captured, officials were dispatched to announce the victory with sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and the Altar of Land and Grain, and the captive-presentation rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiyou day, Jahangir's capture was announced at the ancestral temple and altar with a captive presentation.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禦午門受俘。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor received the captive at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the captive was presented at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 晉長齡太保。

translations.literal: Changling was promoted to Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Changling was made grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 加楊芳太子太保。

translations.literal: Yang Fang was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fang was made grand guardian of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上廷訊張格爾罪，磔於市。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor held court to try Jahangir's crime; he was dismembered at the market.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Jahangir was tried at court and dismembered in the market.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命圖平定回疆四十功臣及軍機大臣曹振鏞、文孚、王鼎、玉麟像於紫光閣。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, portraits were ordered painted in the Ziguang Pavilion of the forty meritorious officials who settled the Western Regions and of Grand Councilors Cao Zhenyong, Wen Fu, Wang Ding, and Yu Lin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, forty Xinjiang meritorious officers and councilors Cao Zhenyong, Wen Fu, Wang Ding, and Yu Lin were painted in Ziguang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北駐紮歉區黃州協兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, stored grain was loaned to soldiers of the Huangzhou garrison command in the disaster-struck garrison area of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huangzhou garrison soldiers in Hubei disaster areas received loaned grain.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，揚威將軍、大學士長齡凱旋，命鄭親王烏爾恭阿等迎勞。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guiyou: Changling, Pacification General and Grand Secretary, returned in triumph; Prince Ulgungga and others were ordered to welcome and reward him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiyou day, Changling returned victorious and Ulgungga and others were sent to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命長齡管理籓院。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Changling was ordered to manage the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Changling was put in charge of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，朝鮮國王李鍚以回疆平定，遣使表賀進方物。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: Korean king Li Xi, because the Western Regions had been pacified, sent envoys with a congratulatory memorial and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on jiachen day, Korea's Li Xi congratulated the Xinjiang pacification with envoys and gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以升寅為熱河都統，以那清安署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Sheng Yin was made Rehe commander; Na Qing'an was ordered to act as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Sheng Yin became Rehe commander and Na Qing'an again acted at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，萬壽節，停止筵宴。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: on the Longevity Festival, banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou day, the longevity feast was stopped.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以成格為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Chengge was made Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Chengge became Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 調盧坤為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Lu Kun was transferred to be governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 以徐炘為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Xu Xin was made governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xin became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，命奕紹、托津、富俊、陳若霖留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Yishao, Tuojin, Fujun, and Chen Ruolin were ordered to remain in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Yishao, Tuojin, Fujun, and Chen Ruolin were left in Beijing to manage affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，給浙江淳安等四縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, grain rations were given for flood disasters in four counties of Zhejiang including Chun'an.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood victims in four Zhejiang counties including Chun'an received grain.

sentences.zh: 貸長蘆被淹灶戶工本。

translations.literal: Working capital was loaned to salt-field households of Changlu drowned by flood.
translations.idiomatic: Changlu flood-struck salt households received loaned working capital.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩浙江淳安等四縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted and deferred for four counties of Zhejiang including Chun'an.
translations.idiomatic: New and old levies were remitted or deferred in four Zhejiang counties including Chun'an.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌朔，日食。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day wuxu: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on the new moon, wuxu day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上謁東陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota levies on places the route passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs with three-tenths tax relief on the route.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以寶華峪工程不慎，褫英和職，降戴均元三品頂戴。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, because the Baohuayu project had been handled carelessly, Ying He was stripped of office and Dai Junyuan was reduced to a third-rank button.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, careless work at Baohuayu cost Ying He his post and Dai Junyuan his second-rank button.

sentences.zh: 己酉，謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵，並祭孝穆皇后殯宮。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, he visited Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, Jingling, and Yuling, and also sacrificed at the mourning palace of Empress Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, he visited the Eastern tombs and sacrificed at Empress Xiaomu's mourning palace.

sentences.zh: 褫戴均元職。

translations.literal: Dai Junyuan was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Junyuan lost his post.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，謁裕陵，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, he visited Yuling and performed the great feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor visited Yuling and held the great feast rite.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，下英和於獄，籍其家。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Ying He was imprisoned and his household property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Ying He was jailed and his property was seized.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the Emperor returned to Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted three-tenths of quota levies on places the route passed through.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs with three-tenths tax relief on the route.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, he visited Tailing, Taodongling, and Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, he visited Tailing, Taodongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 戊午，謁昌陵，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, he visited Changling and performed the great feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor visited Changling and held the great feast rite.

sentences.zh: 庚申，逮戴均元下獄，籍其家。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Dai Junyuan was arrested and imprisoned, and his household property was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Dai Junyuan was arrested, jailed, and his property seized.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, the Emperor returned to Yuanmingyuan.

sentences.zh: 調特依順保為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Te Yishunbao was transferred to be general at Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Te Yishunbao became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 以那彥寶為綏遠城將軍，達淩阿為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was made general at Suiyuan; Dalin'a was made consultant minister at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng took Suiyuan and Dalin'a became Tarbagatai consultant minister.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑兩淮海州屬中正等三場灶戶水災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for flood disasters at three salt fields of the Liang-Huai region including Zhongzheng in Haizhou prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief went to three Liang-Huai salt fields in Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 貸回疆西四城兵丁茶價銀。

translations.literal: Silver for tea prices was loaned to soldiers of the four western cities of the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers of Xinjiang's four western cities received loaned tea-price silver.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚午，英和遣戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengwu: Ying He was banished in penal service to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on gengwu day, Ying He was exiled to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，復惇郡王綿愷為惇親王。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Prince Dun Junwang Mian Kai was restored as Prince Dun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Prince Dun Junwang Mian Kai was restored as Prince Dun.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇海州等三州縣衛、浙江建德等五縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for flood disasters in three prefectures, counties, and guards of Jiangsu including Haizhou and in five counties of Zhejiang including Jiande.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief went to Haizhou in Jiangsu and five Zhejiang counties including Jiande.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇高郵等九州縣、安徽泗州等二十六縣水災旱災一月口糧。

translations.literal: One month's grain rations were given for flood and drought disasters in nine prefectures and counties of Jiangsu including Gaoyou and in twenty-six counties of Anhui including Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: One month's grain went to nine Jiangsu districts including Gaoyou and twenty-six Anhui districts including Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 貸奉天廣寧等處水災旗民口糧，浙江富陽縣貧民穀石，齊齊合爾等處旗營官莊銀糧。

translations.literal: Grain rations were loaned to Banner households flooded in Fengtian places including Guangning; grain and stone were given to poor people of Fuyang county, Zhejiang; and silver and grain were loaned to official estates of Banner camps at Qiqiha'er and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Flooded Fengtian Banner households, Fuyang poor, and Qiqiha'er garrison estates received loans of grain or silver.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇海州等三十六州廳縣衛、安徽泗州等二十六州縣、浙江海寧等十三州縣旱災水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted and deferred for thirty-six prefectures, departments, counties, guards, and departments of Jiangsu including Haizhou, for twenty-six prefectures and counties of Anhui including Sizhou, and for thirteen prefectures and counties of Zhejiang including Haining, stricken by drought and flood.
translations.idiomatic: Levies were remitted or deferred in thirty-six Jiangsu districts, twenty-six Anhui districts, and thirteen Zhejiang districts hit by drought and flood.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，上皇太后徽號曰恭慈安豫康成皇太后。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiachen: the Empress Dowager's honorific title was declared to be Empress Dowager Gong Ci An Yu Kang Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiachen day, the empress dowager received the honorific Gong Ci An Yu Kang Cheng.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以加上皇太后徽號禮成，頒詔天下，覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day yisi, because the rites for adding the Empress Dowager's honorific title had been completed, an edict was promulgated throughout the empire and grace was extended by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, after the empress dowager honorific rites, an empire-wide edict granted graded amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己未，釋戴均元。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Dai Junyuan was released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Dai Junyuan was released.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑浙江富陽縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for the flood disaster in Fuyang county, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief went to Fuyang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 給盛京甯古塔等處水災口糧。

translations.literal: Grain rations were given for flood disasters at Ningguta and other places in Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: Flood victims at Ningguta and other Shengjing places received grain.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，那彥成奏招降附霍罕之額提格訥部落。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinsi: Nayancheng memorialized that he had won over the surrender of the Etiogene tribe attached to Khoqand.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi day, Nayancheng reported winning the surrender of Khoqand's Etiogene tribe.

sentences.zh: 諭嘉之，令妥為撫馭。

translations.literal: An edict praised this and ordered that they be properly settled and governed.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised the report and ordered proper settlement and control.

sentences.zh: 是歲，琉球、朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu and Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Ryukyu and Korea sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月丁未，希皮察克愛曼布魯特阿仔和卓來降。

translations.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, day dingwei: Azi Hezhuo of the Hipichak Aiman Brut came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, on first-month dingwei day, Azi Hezhuo of the Hipichak Aiman Brut submitted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，楊芳加太子太傅。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Yang Fang was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Yang Fang became grand tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 是月，給安徽泗州等五州縣並屯坐衛、江蘇海州等十五州縣衛災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's ration grain was issued to disaster victims in five Anhui prefectures and counties including Sizhou and their garrison troops, and in fifteen Jiangsu prefectures, counties, and guards including Haizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, one month's rations went to five Anhui districts including Sizhou and fifteen Jiangsu districts including Haizhou.

sentences.zh: 賑兩淮板浦等三場被災貧丁。

translations.literal: Relief was given to impoverished laborers affected at three Liang-Huai salt fields including Banpu.
translations.idiomatic: Impoverished laborers at Banpu and two other Liang-Huai salt fields were relieved.

sentences.zh: 貸山西代州、解州水災籽種，河南上蔡縣水災倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned for flood disaster in Daizhou and Xiezhou, Shanxi; granary grain was loaned for flood disaster in Shangcai, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi's Daizhou and Xiezhou received seed loans and Henan's Shangcai received granary grain for floods.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，禦經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jisi, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上奉皇太后幸圓明園。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 霍罕西南達爾瓦斯部落遣使內附，諭嘉獎卻之。

translations.literal: The Darvas tribe southwest of Khoqand sent envoys to submit; they were commended but their gifts were declined.
translations.idiomatic: Khoqand's southwestern Darvas tribe submitted; the court commended them but declined gifts.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命吉林將軍博啟圖為御前大臣，以瑚松額代之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Boqitu was made an imperial presence minister; Husong'e replaced him as Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Boqitu became an imperial presence minister and Husong'e took Jilin.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingwu: the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingwu, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上行圍，至辛亥皆如之。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the battue; through xinhai it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park through xinhai.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，西藏徼外拉達克部長呈進奏表。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the chief of Ladakh beyond Tibet's frontier presented a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Ladakh's frontier chief sent a memorial.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上御閱武樓閱京營兵。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor reviewed Metropolitan garrison troops at the Review Martial Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day, the Emperor reviewed capital garrison troops at the Review Martial Tower.

sentences.zh: 戊午，召琦善，以訥爾經額為山東巡撫，硃桂楨為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Qishan was summoned; Nierjing'e was made Shandong governor; Zhu Guizhen was made grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Qishan was recalled, Nierjing'e took Shandong, and Zhu Guizhen grain transport.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，召戴三錫，以琦善為四川總督。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou: Dai Sanxi was summoned; Qishan was made Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, guiyou, Dai Sanxi was recalled and Qishan became Sichuan governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬午，屠之申以讞獄錯誤降，松筠署直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Tu Zhishen was demoted for errors in capital-punishment review; Songyun acted as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Tu Zhishen was demoted over review errors and Songyun acted for Zhili.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，奉皇太后禦含輝樓閱皇子及侍衛等騎射。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Empress Dowager at Huihui Tower reviewed the archery of princes and guards.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Empress Dowager at Huihui Tower reviewed princes' and guards' archery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜李振鈞等二百二十一人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Li Zhenjun and 221 others received jinshi degrees with differentiated ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Li Zhenjun and 221 others received jinshi degrees.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖南乾州等五廳州縣上年旱災口糧籽種、山西朔州等二十三州廳縣歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, ration and seed grain were loaned for last year's drought in five Hunan prefectures and counties including Qianzhou; granary grain was loaned for harvest shortfall in twenty-three Shanxi prefectures and counties including Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Qianzhou and four other Hunan districts received drought rations and seed loans, and twenty-three Shanxi districts including Shuozhou received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，移孝穆皇后梓宮于寶華峪正殿，神牌於東配殿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingyou: Empress Xiaomu's coffin was moved to the main hall at Baohua Valley; her spirit tablet to the east side hall.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, dingyou, Empress Xiaomu's coffin went to Baohua Valley's main hall and her tablet to the east side hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北荊州城守、水師二營及宜都營被水倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to the Jingzhou city garrison, the two water-forces camps, and the Yidu camp flooded in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flooded Hubei garrisons at Jingzhou, the water-forces camps, and Yidu received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，以福釂為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yichou: Fukule was made Kobdo assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, yichou, Fukule became Kobdo assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己巳，免西藏喀喇烏蘇等處雪災番族貢馬銀，並撫恤達木八旗被災官兵戶口。

translations.literal: On day jisi, tribute-horse silver was remitted for snow disasters in Karawusu and other places in Tibet, and households of officers and soldiers of the eight Damu banners affected by disaster were also relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Karawusu snow-disaster tribute silver was remitted and Damu banner disaster households were relieved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，伊犁將軍德英阿卒，以玉麟代之。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Ili General Deying'a died; Yu Lin replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Deying'a died and Yu Lin became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 調松筠為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Songyun was transferred to Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun became minister of war.

sentences.zh: 以博啟圖為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Boqitu was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Boqitu became minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，召安福，以福克精額署察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Anfu was summoned; Fukejing'e acted as Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Anfu was recalled and Fukejing'e acted as Chahar commandant.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸三姓地方上年被水倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for last year's flood at Sanxing.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Sanxing received a granary loan for last year's flood.

sentences.zh: 七月己亥，申嚴粵海關官銀出洋、私貨入口禁。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jihai: the ban on official silver leaving the Canton customs and on private goods entering was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, jihai, the ban on Canton customs silver exports and private imports was tightened.

sentences.zh: 以紮隆阿為喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Zhalong'a was made Kashgar assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhalong'a became Kashgar assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，越南國王以母老乞葠芪，上嘉賚之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, because his mother was aged, the king of Vietnam begged ginseng and astragalus; the Emperor graciously bestowed them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Vietnam's king received imperial gifts of ginseng and astragalus for his aged mother.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑廣西雒容、永福二縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for Luorong and Yongfu counties, Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Luorong and Yongfu in Guangxi received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 免安徽泗州五河縣，鳳陽、泗州二衛上年被水錢糧十分之一。

translations.literal: One-tenth of last year's flood quota levies was remitted for Wuhe county, Sizhou, and the Fengyang and Sizhou guards.
translations.idiomatic: Wuhe, Sizhou, and the Fengyang and Sizhou guards lost one-tenth of last year's flood quotas.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，以謁盛京祖陵，命奕紹、托津、湯金釗、明山留京辦事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guihai: because the Emperor would visit the ancestral tombs at Shengjing, Yishao, Tuojin, Tang Jinzhao, and Mingshan were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, guihai, Yishao, Tuojin, Tang Jinzhao, and Mingshan stayed in Beijing for the Shengjing tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上奉皇太后謁盛京祖陵。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, visited the ancestral tombs at Shengjing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Shengjing's ancestral tombs.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰朔，日食。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon on day renchen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the ninth-month new moon, renchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 免蹕路經過之承德等五廳州縣本年額賦，及幫辦差務之岫岩等九廳州縣額賦十分之五。

translations.literal: This year's quota levies were remitted for five subprefectures and counties including Chengde on the imperial route; half the quota levies were remitted for nine subprefectures and counties including Xiuyan that assisted the errands.
translations.idiomatic: Route districts including Chengde lost this year's quotas, and Xiuyan and eight other errand districts lost half.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，朝鮮貢使李相璜等迎覲。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Korean tribute envoy Li Xianghuang and others were received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Li Xianghuang and other Korean envoys were received.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上親射，並閱盛京官兵等騎射。

translations.literal: On day yisi, the Emperor shot archery personally and reviewed the archery of Shengjing officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, the Emperor shot and reviewed Shengjing troops' archery.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謁永陵。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor visited Yongling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor visited Yongling.

sentences.zh: 戊申，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the great feast rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the great feast rite was held.

sentences.zh: 閱興京城。

translations.literal: The Emperor inspected Xingjing city.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inspected Xingjing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，博啟圖降調，以耆英為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Boqitu was demoted and transferred; Qiying was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Boqitu was demoted and Qiying took the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 上謁福陵，臨奠弘毅公額亦都墓，加恩後裔博克順等。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited Fuling, offered at the tomb of Count Hongyi Eidu, and bestowed favors on descendants including Bokesun.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuling the Emperor mourned Count Hongyi Eidu and favored descendants including Bokesun.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，行大饗禮。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the great feast rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, the great feast rite was held.

sentences.zh: 上至盛京，詣太廟寶冊前行禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor reached Shengjing and performed rites before the spirit tablets at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At Shengjing the Emperor worshipped before the ancestral temple tablets.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上詣天壇、堂子。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor visited the Altar of Heaven and the Tangzi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the Emperor visited the Altar of Heaven and the Tangzi.

sentences.zh: 奉皇太后幸嘉廕堂。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager visited Jiayin Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager visited Jiayin Hall.

sentences.zh: 臨奠克勤郡王嶽讬墓。

translations.literal: The Emperor offered at the tomb of Prince Keqin Yuetuo.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mourned at Prince Keqin Yuetuo's tomb.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李鍚遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Korean king Li Xi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Korea's King Li Xi sent envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詣地壇。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Emperor visited the Altar of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, the Emperor visited the Altar of Earth.

sentences.zh: 臨奠直義公費英東墓。

translations.literal: The Emperor offered at the tomb of Duke Zhiyi Fei Yingdong.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mourned at Duke Zhiyi Fei Yingdong's tomb.

sentences.zh: 己未，上御大政殿，賜扈從王、公、大臣，蒙古王、貝勒、貝子、公及盛京文武官員宴賞有差。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, at Dagong Hall the Emperor granted a feast to accompanying princes, dukes, and ministers, Mongol princes, beile, beizi, and dukes, and Shengjing civil and military officials, with differentiated rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, at Dagong Hall the Emperor feasted the entourage and Shengjing officials with graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 十月，以潘世恩署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Pan Shien acted as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, Pan Shien acted at the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 辛未，皇太后聖壽節，上率扈從王、公、大臣詣皇太后行宮行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, on the Empress Dowager's birthday the Emperor led accompanying princes, dukes, and ministers to her traveling palace to perform congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, the Empress Dowager's birthday brought congratulations at her traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 上奉皇太后幸澄海樓。

translations.literal: The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Chenghai Tower.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Chenghai Tower.

sentences.zh: 壬午，謁裕陵。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, the Emperor visited Yuling.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以吳光悅為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Wu Guangyue was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, Wu Guangyue became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上奉皇太后還宮。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, the Emperor brought the Empress Dowager back to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是月，給安徽泗州等五州縣卫一月口糧。

translations.literal: That month, one month's ration grain was issued to five Anhui prefectures and counties including Sizhou and their guards.
translations.idiomatic: That month, five Anhui districts including Sizhou and their guards received one month's rations.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，召英惠，調成格為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingsi: Yinghui was summoned; Chengge was transferred to be Urumqi commander.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, dingsi, Yinghui was recalled and Chengge became Urumqi commander.

sentences.zh: 以裕恩為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Yu'en was made Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yu'en became Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天遼陽等五處被災旗民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, relief ration grain was issued to banner people affected by disaster in five places including Liaoyang, Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liaoyang and four other Fengtian districts received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，緬甸國王孟既遣使表賀。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: Burma king Meng Ji sent envoys with a congratulatory memorial.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiazi, Burma's Meng Ji sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，撫恤西藏三十九族成災番民。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Tibetan subjects of the thirty-nine tribes who suffered disaster were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, disaster victims among Tibet's thirty-nine tribes were relieved.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山東益都、臨朐二縣地震災。

translations.literal: That month, earthquake relief was given for Yidu and Linqu counties, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shandong's Yidu and Linqu received earthquake relief.

sentences.zh: 蠲直隸隆平、甯晉二縣窪地額賦之五。

translations.literal: Half the quota levies on lowlands were remitted for Longping and Ningjin counties, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: Longping and Ningjin in Zhili lost half their lowland quota levies.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丁巳，暹羅國王鄭福遣使表賀，並貢方物。

translations.literal: Tenth year, spring, first month, day dingsi: Siam king Zheng Fu sent envoys with a congratulatory memorial and local products.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10, on first-month dingsi day, Siam's Zheng Fu sent congratulatory envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇沛縣、安徽盱眙等六州縣衛旱災水災。

translations.literal: That month, drought and flood relief was given for six Jiangsu and Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Pei county and Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, six districts including Jiangsu's Pei county and Anhui's Xuyi received drought and flood relief.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸滄州、鹽山二州縣，甘肅皋蘭等十四州縣旱災水災銀穀。

translations.literal: Silver and grain were loaned for drought and flood in Cangzhou and Yanshan, Zhili, and fourteen prefectures and counties including Gaolan, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili's Cangzhou and Yanshan and fourteen Gansu districts including Gaolan received drought-and-flood silver and grain loans.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day renxu: the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renxu, the Emperor attended the Classics Lecture.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命緝捕河南梟匪、撚匪。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, arrest of Henan xiaofei and Nian bandits was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Henan xiaofei and Nian bandits were ordered captured.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命緝捕江西上猶縣會匪。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, arrest of hui bandits in Shangyou county, Jiangxi, was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Shangyou hui bandits in Jiangxi were ordered captured.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，以謁西陵，命奕紹、托津、長齡、盧廕溥留京辦事。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: because the Emperor would visit the Western Tombs, Yishao, Tuojin, Chang Ling, and Lu Yinpu were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengyin, Yishao, Tuojin, Chang Ling, and Lu Yinpu stayed in Beijing for the Western Tombs visit.

sentences.zh: 己亥，免湖南澧州濱湖淤田額賦並前借籽種銀。

translations.literal: On day jihai, quota levies and previously loaned seed silver were remitted for lakeside silt fields at Lizhou, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, Lizhou's lakeside silt fields lost quota levies and seed loans.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，上奉皇太后謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 以升寅為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Sheng Yin was made Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng Yin became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，調瑚松額為盛京將軍，以福克精阿為吉林將軍，武忠額為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Husong'e was transferred to Shengjing general; Fukejing'a to Jilin general; Wu Zhong'e to Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, Husong'e took Shengjing, Fukejing'a Jilin, and Wu Zhong'e Chahar.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 己酉，上幸南苑。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, the Emperor visited the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上行圍，至壬子如之。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the battue; through renzi it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park through renzi.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以哈薩克汗阿勒坦沙喇等請遣其子入覲，命至熱河陛見。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because Kazakh Khan Altanshara and others asked to send their sons for audience, they were ordered to audience at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Altanshara and other Kazakh khans were told to bring their sons to audience at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 四月辛未，申禁外省才不勝任之員改京職。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day xinwei: transfer of incompetent provincial officials to capital posts was strictly forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinwei, incompetent provincials were barred from capital transfers.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，河南、直隸毗連十四州縣地震，命加意撫恤。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: earthquakes struck fourteen prefectures and counties bordering Henan and Zhili; careful relief was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, xinyou, fourteen Henan-Zhili border districts were ordered carefully relieved after earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，蔣攸銛有疾，以陶澍署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinmao: because Jiang Youshen was ill, Tao Shu acted as Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, xinmao, Jiang Youshen's illness put Tao Shu in at Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以程祖洛為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Cheng Zuluo was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Cheng Zuluo became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 七月丙子，暹羅遣使賀萬壽貢方物。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day bingzi: Siam sent envoys congratulating the Longevity Festival with local products.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, bingzi, Siam sent Longevity Festival envoys with local products.

sentences.zh: 免江蘇海州四州縣舊欠額賦。

translations.literal: Old arrears in quota levies were remitted for four counties of Haizhou, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Four Haizhou counties in Jiangsu lost old quota arrears.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，萬壽節，停筵宴。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yiwei: on the Longevity Festival, banquets were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, yiwei, Longevity Festival banquets were cancelled.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，召蔣攸銛來京，授陶澍兩江總督。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Jiang Youshen was summoned to the capital; Tao Shu was appointed Liangjiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Jiang Youshen was recalled and Tao Shu took Liangjiang.

sentences.zh: 調盧坤為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Lu Kun was transferred to Jiangsu governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun became Jiangsu governor.

sentences.zh: 以硃桂楨為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: Zhu Guizhen was made Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Guizhen became Guangdong governor.

sentences.zh: 命吳邦慶以三品銜署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Wu Bangqing was ordered to act as grain-transport governor-general with third-rank title.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bangqing acted as grain-transport governor-general at third rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，加賑湖北監利等四縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, additional flood relief was given for four counties including Jianli, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jianli and three other Hubei counties received extra flood relief.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，安集延回匪復入喀什噶爾，幫辦大臣塔斯哈戰敗，死之，遂圍喀什噶爾城。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: Andijan Hui rebels again entered Kashgar; assistant commissioner Taskha was defeated and killed; they then besieged Kashgar city.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, wuwu, Andijan rebels retook Kashgar, killed Taskha, and besieged the city.

sentences.zh: 命玉麟等往剿。

translations.literal: Yu Lin and others were ordered to campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Lin and others were ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 命楊遇春駐肅州，楊芳、胡超率陝甘兵協剿。

translations.literal: Yang Yuchun was ordered stationed at Suzhou in Gansu; Yang Fang and Hu Chao were to lead Shaanxi-Gansu troops in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yuchun was posted to Gansu Suzhou; Yang Fang and Hu Chao led Shaanxi-Gansu troops to assist.

sentences.zh: 以鄂山署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: E Shan was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: E Shan acted as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 徐炘署陝西巡撫，阿勒精阿署山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Xu Xin acted as Shaanxi governor; Alejing'a acted as Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xin took acting Shaanxi and Alejing'a acting Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 己未，以楊遇春為欽差大臣，督辦軍務。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Yang Yuchun was made imperial commissioner to supervise military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Yang Yuchun became imperial commissioner over the campaign.

sentences.zh: 以英惠署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Yinghui acted as Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghui acted as Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，命長齡為欽差大臣，率桂輪、阿勒罕保等赴新疆。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Changling was ordered as imperial commissioner to lead Guilun, Alehanbao, and others to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Changling was sent as imperial commissioner with Guilun and Alehanbao to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以玉英署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yuying acted as Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yuying acted as Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor reviewed Firearms Brigade troops.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Brigade.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大學士蔣攸銛以讞獄誤，降侍郎。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Grand Secretary Jiang Youshen was demoted to vice minister for a criminal-case error.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Jiang Youshen was demoted from Grand Secretary for a trial error.

sentences.zh: 召徐炘來京，以顏伯燾署陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Xu Xin was summoned to the capital; Yan Bozhao acted as Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Xin was recalled and Yan Bozhao acted as Shaanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以盧廕溥為大學士，李鴻賓協辦大學士，仍留兩廣總督任。

translations.literal: Lu Yinpu was made Grand Secretary; Li Hongbin cooperating Grand Secretary while remaining Guangdong governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yinpu became Grand Secretary; Li Hongbin joined as assistant while keeping Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 調湯金釗為吏部尚書，王引之為禮部尚書，潘世恩為工部尚書，硃士彥為左都御史。

translations.literal: Tang Jinzhao was transferred as Minister of Personnel; Wang Yinzhi Minister of Rites; Pan Shien Minister of Works; Zhu Shiyan Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Jinzhao took Personnel, Wang Yinzhi Rites, Pan Shien Works, and Zhu Shiyan the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸磁州等三州縣地震災、四川彭城等二縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, earthquake relief was given for Cizhou and two other prefectures and counties in Zhili, and flood relief for Pengcheng and one other county in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhili earthquake districts and two Sichuan flood counties were relieved.

sentences.zh: 十月，以盧廕溥為體仁閣大學士。

translations.literal: Tenth month: Lu Yinpu was made Grand Secretary of the Tirenge Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Lu Yinpu became Tirenge Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以富呢揚阿為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Funiyang'a was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Funiyang'a became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，仍授長齡為揚威將軍，命哈哴阿、楊芳參贊軍務。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Changling was again appointed Yangwei General; Hala'a and Yang Fang were ordered to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Changling was again made Yangwei General; Hala'a and Yang Fang assisted the campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以樂善為烏裏雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Leshan was made Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Leshan became Uliasutai general.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以軍事遲誤，褫伊犁參贊大臣容安職並所襲子爵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, for delay in military affairs, Ili assistant commissioner Rong'an was stripped of office and his inherited viscount rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Rong'an lost office and his viscount title for military delay.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以恩銘為烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Enming was made Uliasutai assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Enming became Uliasutai assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，回匪犯葉爾羌，壁昌等擊敗之。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Muslim rebels attacked Yarkand; Bichang and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, rebels struck Yarkand and Bichang repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 丁未，逮容安。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Rong'an was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, Rong'an was arrested.

sentences.zh: 壬子，召富呢揚阿來京。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Funiyang'a was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Funiyang'a was recalled to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸大城、文安二縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims were relieved in Dacheng and Wen'an, two counties in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dacheng and Wen'an in Zhili received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽蕪湖等五州縣衛口糧。

translations.literal: Rations were distributed to five prefectures, counties, and garrisons including Wuhu in Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Anhui districts including Wuhu received ration relief.

sentences.zh: 貸黑龍江等三處旗民倉穀、甘肅皋蘭等十一州縣貧民口糧。

translations.literal: Granary grain was loaned to banner people in three places including Heilongjiang, and rations loaned to the poor in eleven prefectures and counties including Gaolan in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Heilongjiang bannermen and eleven Gansu districts including Gaolan received grain loans.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以楊懌曾為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: Yang Yizeng was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Yang Yizeng became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，申諭李鴻賓等查辦廣東會匪。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Li Hongbin and others were sternly instructed to investigate Guangdong secret societies.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Li Hongbin was ordered to root out Guangdong secret societies.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，諭吳光悅查辦江西贛南會匪。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Wu Guangyue was instructed to investigate secret societies in southern Gannan, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Wu Guangyue was told to suppress Jiangxi Gannan secret societies.

sentences.zh: 壬午，嵩孚降調，以盧坤為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Songfu was demoted and transferred; Lukang was made Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Songfu was demoted and Lukang became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調程祖洛江蘇巡撫，蘇成額湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Zuluo was transferred as Jiangsu governor, and Su Chenge Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zuluo took Jiangsu and Su Chenge Hunan.

sentences.zh: 以祁宇為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Qi Yu was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Yu became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 以阿勒精阿為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Alejing'a was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Alejing'a became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑河南安陽等三縣地震災。

translations.literal: That month, earthquake relief was given for Anyang and two other counties in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Anyang and two other Henan counties were relieved after the earthquake.

sentences.zh: 給江西廬陵縣水災修屋費。

translations.literal: Funds were given to Luling County, Jiangxi, to repair houses after flood damage.
translations.idiomatic: Luling in Jiangxi received flood-damage house-repair funds.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，托津免管刑部，以盧廕溥代之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guisi: Tuojin was relieved of managing the Board of Punishments; Lu Yinpu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guisi day, Tuojin left punishments and Lu Yinpu took over.

sentences.zh: 丙申，喀什噶爾、英吉沙爾回匪平。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Muslim rebels in Kashgar and Yengisar were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Kashgar and Yengisar rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 予死事喀什噶爾幫辦大臣塔斯哈都統銜。

translations.literal: Taskha, the Kashgar assistant commissioner who died in service, was granted military superintendent rank posthumously.
translations.idiomatic: Taskha, the Kashgar aide killed in action, was posthumously given superintendent rank.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑雲南嶍峨縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for Yixian County in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yunnan's Yixian County received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇蘇州等四府州屬駐近災區兵丁銀米。

translations.literal: Silver and grain were loaned to soldiers stationed near disaster areas in four prefectures and districts including Suzhou in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangsu troops near disaster zones, including Suzhou, received silver and grain loans.
